description:
Welcome to our enchanting apartment nestled in a renovated historic building in Yeldeğirmeni, with easy access to everywhere. This space is perfectly suited for up to 4 guests, with a boasting bedroom, a spacious living area, a fully-equipped kitchen, and a clean toilet. The living room features a comfy sofa that transforms into a bed for two, ensuring a peaceful sleep.

Enjoy sea and sunset views on the unique terrace, which provides the perfect environment for relaxing and socializing.

reviews.text: Sena is a very responsive host and I'm really thankful for the welcoming gifts. Her apartment looks exactly like in the photos. It's located on the last floor of an old building (there's no elevator). The interior is renovated, but it preserves an original classical look really well. It is a very atmospheric apartment! The kitchen is small, but has most of the stuff you'll need for a good stay (no washing machine, though). The biggest downside of my stay was the temperature inside - there was no central heating and the three available electric heaters couldn't keep the apartment warm enough. But I was there at rather cold times. I believe that in warm months the experience is much better as you also would use the balcony quite often.

I loved my stay at Senas place, it’s a gorgeous apartment in such a fun neighborhood. We loved the cafe just outside our doorstep, and the neighborhood is lovely with lots of bars and restaurants but gets quiet early enough that you can have a peaceful nights sleep. The photos don’t do the place justice, it’s spacious, clean and stylish. The kitchen is small but has absolutely everything you need. The hosts are very responsive and kind. I can’t wait to come back.

We had an amazing stay at the apartment of Sena and Hayri during our Christmas vacation.
The flat is very charming, well maintained, has everything you need and is incredibly comfortable with three balconies (the large one with a view of the Marmara Sea).
The flat is also ideal for winter vacations, because the heating system works well and there is an additional radiator — just in case — for extra heat.
Located in Rasimpasa, a peaceful neighborhood, it‘s close to nice coffee shops and restaurants, shops and supermarkets. Also easily accessible is the public transport, including the ferry station and the metro, just five minutes away by walking.
Sena and Hayri are exceptional hosts — responsive and very kind.
Thank you for a wonderful stay, the flat is highly recommended!
We plan to come back very soon.
Best regards, Michael and Christine

reviews.text:

reviews.text:
The host - Irem was always responsive and very helpful. The location is right in the center and felt very safe, and the apartment is exactly as described, spacious and looks like the photos.
I extended my stay to about a month because I got a good deal. As other reviews mention, it’s good for shorter stays though, as there’s no direct sunlight so it’s a little dark and bars downstairs can make it a bit loud, though you don’t really hear it once the bedroom door is closed. For longer stays that may become a problem.
Cleaning was a bit unclear at first as some reviews mentioned it was included in the fee, but since I stayed longer term it was kindly provided for free, which I appreciated. Overall I enjoyed the stay.

The host was very responsive, very clear with instructions and overall very pleasant with clear communication.
The apartment is as described, and actually in some ways even better, for example it includes daily cleaning free of charge, which is a very positive surprise for an AirBnb.
My issue with the apartment is that it's located in a very noisy area, which on one hand can be useful, because there is so much to do around, but at night especially weekends it's noisy. If you close the windows and close the bedroom door, you'll be fine, but just not super convenient.
The apartment is in an old building, and the ceilings are not very high, and not much light gets in, because while you can open the curtains, you would lose all privacy, as your neighbors across the little street would look directly into your apartment.
Overall, it's a nice apartment, well located in terms of being close to action, restaurants, bars, etc, but very noisy - I would probably stay here for a weekend, not a week

Lovely apartment in an ideal location just off Istiklal! VERY spacious living room with beautiful full-length windows and balconies. Easy to check in and the digital key was very convenient. Great lighting and power outlets next to each side of the bed. On weekend nights the restaurants and bars below could be a bit noisy but nothing unmanageable (pretty standard for Istiklal).
The host was kind and easy to communicate with. The apartment was clean, comfy and in a great location. I would come back for sure.
Great place to stay, good location, we liked it very much. At night it was a bit noisy from the bar downstairs, but the doors in the bedroom have good isolation so it didn’t disturb us:)

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. The apartment is a 2-storey duplex. It is decorated in accordance with the historical texture of the neighborhood. You can walk to the 24-hour vibrant life center and the subway in 10 minutes. Its location is very quiet.
We guarantee that you will be satisfied with the comfort of our beds for a comfortable sleep. You can sit in front of the terrace or upstairs window and sip your coffee with a beautiful view of Istanbul.

reviews.text: My stay at Kemal’s place was wonderful. The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well located. Kemal was a thoughtful and responsive host, making sure everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. I especially appreciated the small touches that made the space feel welcoming. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

This place is incredibly cozy, private, and full of charm. Located on a hilltop with a stunning view from the balcony and the second-floor attic bedroom, it's perfect for relaxing, exploring Istanbul, and recharging. Kemal is a friendly and responsive host.
Pros: The tiny but exceptionally cozy bedroom is ideal for romantic or solo stays—it feels straight out of a "lo-fi beats" video cover. All necessary amenities (washing machine, heater, AC, kitchen, Wi-Fi, two TVs) work flawlessly. The Wi-Fi speed (25 Mbps) is good enough for video calls and basic work. Nice cafés, groceries, and ferry/bus stops are all within a 10- 15-minute walk. I'll book it again for sure.
Things to consider: The apartment is uphill, so it might be challenging for elderly guests, children, or people with mobility limitations—but the amazing view makes the climb worth it, and you get used to it. Construction work is also happening not that far away, but all the noise ends within an hour, and it's not permanent.

Absolutely loved my stay at Kemal's apartment. The apartment really felt like a home which is what I wanted. Kemal is a very kind and responsive host. I liked that the mezzanine with the double bed was up stairs and the bottom door could be shut for privacy. The other room with two double beds was downstairs (by the kitchen) also had its own door. There was also a balcony with a gorgeous view of the city. Except for the first day when there was construction, the apartment is super quiet and I slept so amazingly (as someone who is noise sensitive) so would recommend the location. There are many stairs to get up to the property and it's on a hill - I personally didn't mind but just to note. Overall would really recommend staying in Kemal's home, will miss it !

The location is amazing, set near the main points of Istanbul and within 10 minutes away from any bus. And the apartment is great too and the view was amazing. Kemal was a great host too, he helped us to find the best affordable foods and how to avoid tourists trap. And the apartment is cozy, and very clean and beautiful with free shampoo and body wash and cooking oil and coffee etc . However, it is quite cramped and small, so if you have lots of luggage it might feel cramped in there. The upstairs section was spacious but the ceiling is low, if you are a average height person 175cm+, it might be a little difficult as you might head your head multiple times. The other disadvantage is that despite being close and the location amazing, the walk there is very tiring, it is a uphill incline walk combined with the apartment on the 5th floor makes it a tedious challenge as there is no lift and 5 floors up making carrying luggages challenging and everytime you come back, you have to walk up.

Communication with the host was perhaps the most unpleasant part of the experience. To be fair, he generally responded quickly, but quick responses do not make up for rude, angry and disrespectful communication. His tone in some message

reviews.text:
I had a lovely stay at Mustafa’s place. The flat is exactly as described and in a great spot in Fatih. Just keep in mind that if you are heading to the bazaar, the mosques or the palace, you will need to walk uphill.
The room was just what I needed, a comfortable bed and a good shower. It was clean and tidy too. The only minor issue was that the outside lights shone through the curtain at night, which made it a little tricky to sleep at times.
We did not communicate much, but we did not need to, everything was easy to find and straightforward. Overall, a good stay in a very convenient location. Definitely recommend for solo travellers or couples looking for somewhere cheap, clean, and in a good location!

All as listed/described. Very friendly & responsive host. Handy central location with places to eat & drink nearby & short walk to some of the main sights, eg Grand bazaar. Comfortable bed & plenty of hot water. It’s in the shoe-making district so a little bit of noise in the day time but it does stop at night (didn’t bother me).

The host was very responsive from the time we landed in Istanbul up to our departure.
He helped us with transfers from and to the airport.
The location of the property is close to all sightseeing (walking distance), but the street is surrounded by industrial companies. First impression was that it is not safe, later we realized that it is safe. People are working - they are not a threat to anybody's safety. Do not be disappointed by the first impression of the street view.
The room was small, same as advertised. TV, fridge, kettle are there.
We were not happy with the cleanliness of the room and the shower tub.
The rest was good.
The price affordable. The host is helpful and responsive.
Thank you.

the room is exactly like is described! it is very simple, but also very clean and the bed is pretty comfortable. a couple things that are not the fault of the host, but should be stated, regardless. during the daytime, it is a little loud right outside the window. men are shouting a lot. second, you are literally at street level, so you cannot leave the curtains open at all, unless you are ok with those same men staring in. the location is great, so many options for food around and easy to see many of the sights! one thing i would recommend is for slippers to be provided. the room was a bit chilly (march), but luckily, i had my own slippers with me. that said, i would gladly stay here again.
All as described. Mustafa was very friendly and responsive. Clean, comfy bed and plenty of hot water.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place built according to earthquake regulations, you will be very close to the historical and touristic sites of the city, and if you choose our place, which is also the center of the famous Turkish cuisine at an affordable price, you will be extremely satisfied. The textiles we use in our home are premium quality cotton materials.

reviews.text:
Adnan bey evindeki konaklamamız çok iyi ve rahattı. Daire resimlerdeki gibiydi. Temiz ve iyi donanımlıydı. Adnan Bey çok cana yakındı ve bir şeye ihtiyacımız olduğunda hemen yardımcı oldu. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.
Our stay at Mr. Adnan house was very good and comfortable. The flat was just like the pictures. It was clean and well equipped. Mr. Adnan was very friendly and immediately helps whenever we needed something. Definitely recommend it.
apartment was as described and excellent location. host was helpful too
Adnan beyin iletişimi gayet iyi. Tarihi mekanlara ulaşım için uygun bir nokta. Yemek için çevrede uygun fiyatlı mekanlar var. Fatih camisine çok yakın. Temizlik daha iyi olabilirdi.

There are some things here and there that can be improved (no smart tv, small shower) but the flat has only recently been put out for Airbnb and the host plans to upgrade certain parts.
Otherwise this was a flat that gave us a feeling of a real Turkish home, everything from the decoration to the location. It is located in a local area but still walkable to Sultanahmet area. His apartment is close to many good local restaurants and shops and also the historic Fatih mosque is 5 min walk away.
Adnan was the friendliest host that we have met and a great host that even offered us tea in the tea house under the flat.
His apartment was not just a place to stay but a part of the whole experience of Istanbul and if we ever come back we will for sure visit this place again.

The place fit our family of 6 comfortably. It is a bit run down and needs to be renovated. There is AC only in the main area. The bedrooms do not have AC. The washing machine works but old. The sheets and pillows and the place wasn't clean to our liking.

description: Beautifully styled studio apartment with a small balcony provides comfortable modern accommodation to our guests in the center of Istanbul close to Sultanahmet and Grand bazaar.

reviews.text:
Saban is a great and very responsive host. The apartment was very clean, and we really liked staying here.
We rate the place 4 instead of 5 stars because the 'free parking' is a bit confusing. It's true that you can park for free. However, this is in a different area than the apartment itself and definitely a walk. Saban writes that it's 10 minutes but according to Google Maps it's 15.
Ev sahibi yardımcı oldu ev fotoğraflardaki gibiydi temiz konforlu sessiz bir mahallede onemli konumlara yakın dinlenmek için bire bir teşekkürler
Exactly as described. Very very good value for money - thank you!

Saban bey giriş konusunda çok yardımcı oldu her şey 10 numaraydı. Sadece konuma giderken mapsin ara sokaklardan götürmesi yüzünden çok güvende hissedemedik onun dışında temizlik ve rahatlık açısından iyiydi.

ev konum olarak güzel bir yerde. toplu taşımaya yakın. gezilecek yerlere yakın. kısa süreli konaklamalar için çok uygun Şaban bey her şeye çok hızlı cevap veriyor. çok ilgili ve anlayışlı bir ev sahibi.

description: Due to its central location, it covers all the historical beauties of old Istanbul, including famous restaurants and entertainment. Very close to many historical sites and museums. It is possible to reach many historical places and districts with or without transfers, just 1 minute walk to the newly opened Kumkapı metro and just 5 minutes walk to the Beyazıt tram. Within walking distance to places to visit such as Beyazıt Square, Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and Sultan Ahmet Mosque

reviews.text: The best part of the stay was the lovely host, Vahap. Besides that, the entire hotel smells like mold/mildew, which is why I cut my stay short as I am very sensitive to mold. I stayed in room 6 and I kept smelling it near the bed and bathroom which share a wall. The “double bed” is actually two very cheap twin-sized mattresses pushed together. It was very uncomfortable and I had a very hard time sleeping. Additionally, there is WiFi but it only works well right next to the entrance of the room, it doesn’t reach to the bed which is the only place to sit in the room. The lighting above the bed was very harsh, almost unusable. There is a patio but it is also unusable. The door to the room was broken by a previous guest, but still useable once you figure it out. The neighborhood did not feel safe to me, but it is very close to a major train station which is nice. I don’t like leaving poor reviews, but this place needs a lot of maintenance.

It was a fantastic experience. Vahap and his friend are incredibly kind and helpful, making me feel welcome as a first-time visitor to Istanbul. The rooms are clean, well-equipped, and comfortable, meeting all my needs. The hotel is located in a safe area, which is perfect for travelers who value security. I highly recommend Tavra Hotel, especially for anyone visiting Istanbul for the first time. It made my trip even more enjoyable!
The room was really nice and clean, looked just like the photos. Walkable distance from most places. The gentleman at the reception was extremely friendly and helpful with anything we needed.

My wife and I stayed here for 3 nights and we were very happy with everything from the room, the staff, and the location.
We checked in at around 3 in the afternoon and they got us into our room very quickly and the front desk attendant was very friendly.
It’s located a short 15 minute walk to the Sultanahmet square with all of its historic sites and the tram and bus stop are also just a few blocks away.
The room itself was exactly what we needed and definitely on par with the price. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom was nice, and the blinds were dark which was good for a nap as we were very tired when we arrived.
All in all it’s a fantastic place to stay if you’re on a budget. We definitely recommend it.

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly, responsive, and made sure everything went smoothly. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text:
Since I myself work in a luxury hotel and travel a lot, I am a rather demanding guest. In general - Nice place to stay.
Good location.
Clean.
Everything is new.
Nice gym,
Awesome steam room, sauna and pool! Everything is clean tidy and comfortable.
Friendly host and all lobby staff members.
One of the shortcomings -
I would like to see some more amenities in the room. Bit better bad and tv.
On my opinion- one of the best variety of price and quality. Highly recommended and definitely will book for next trip.
Modern, clean apartment in a good location. All of the amenities were as described on the listing and were really great to have. Burak was a friendly, responsive host. Would recommend staying here.

We stayed there for 3 weeks.
Great location easy to go to anywhere. 15 minutes walk to taksim square. Bus station is just 3-4 minutes walking distance.
Great facilities as it is described in the description. It felt like home we had all we needed to stay there for three weeks.
Burak was also helpful and helped us get all we needed.

I stayed in this apartment for 5 days. It was just like the pictures, very clean and modern. The location is great - just a 15-minute walk to Taksim Square and 30 minutes to Nisantasi. Burak and his father were very kind, helpful, and always there for us. Everything worked perfectly, and if I come back to Istanbul, I would definitely book this Airbnb again. Thankyou!🌸

Burak was a great host. Super friendly and very respectful. Anytime I ask him for anything he made sure that i get it within 2 hr. The place is in a great location and the parking lot saved us lots of trouble and time.also its really safe to stay there.
I would definitely come back and use his place again

description:
Our unit is very close to the istiklal street in a central location.
This unit consist of:
* One bedroom with a queen size mattress, nightstand, clothing rack, hair dryer, and a small TV
* One living room with a TV, and a sofa bed
* Entrance/hall area with a table and three chairs
* Kitchen with cooking pans, stove, utensils, sink, electric water kettle, washing machine, small fridge
* Bathroom with sink, shower and hot water

reviews.text: Aleksandria was a wonderful host. She was always responsive and kind. The home felt very comfortable for two people and was clean and warm- It was exactly as described. Location was very close to great restaurants, shopping, and public transportation. WIFI was strong and dependable (for those possibly working remote). I would recommend Aleksandria's home to those staying in Istanbul!

If you need good accommodation in central location in Istanbul with good value for money this should be your choice. It’s located in walking distance to most touristic points. From the street house may looks a bit shabby, but once you are inside it’s all good.
Kitchen has only basic facilities, so probably will be challenging if you plan to cook meals regularly yourself. Bathroom is not recently renovated, but decently clean. Bedroom and living room are very good, with nice bed and couch.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The apartment was exactly as described and located in the vital Beyoğlu neighborhood with many food options & transport connection to Fatih (probably the two quarters of top interest in Istanbul).
Aleksandrina gave us a lot of good recommendations, as well as being very friendly and helpful overall. Maybe the biggest upside: Considering three people can stay here, the value for money is hard to beat.

Beautiful apartment, located in safe area and center of taksim. This apartment has everything you need, very comfortable bedroom, washing machine+kitchen room, guess room and tv room with comfortable big sofa. My room also has balcony. Aleksandrina is very responsive and helpful. I definitely book this apartment again when i come again to istnabul

We have spent a week in Aleksandrina’s wonderful apartment, which felt like home away from home. Spacious and comfortable space, cleaned well just before we arrived. Easy and fast communication with Aleksandrina, we could even leave our baggage earlier than usual check-in. Great location, perfect distance from busy Taksim square to walk anywhere in the city. We rested well here after our daytrips, would love to be back!

description: You can relax in this peaceful accommodation. The house is 3 minutes to fly in shopping mall, 5 minutes to Marmaraya aquaflorya, 5-10 minutes to the forest to the sea. My house is 2+1 and there is 1 bedroom, a double bed, a dressing room, a dining table in the living room, 2 sofa beds that can be opened and made up. The kitchen has all the supplies you need. I have one cat in my house, I do not send it from home, it will accompany you during the stay. Please be mindful if you have a cat phobia

reviews.text: The host was exceptionally welcoming and provided an experience that exceeded all our expectations. The accommodation was clean, organized, and very comfortable. The location was ideal, offering both proximity to main attractions and a peaceful environment. Every detail was thoughtfully arranged, and everything we needed was available. The host was always accessible and quick to respond to all our questions, making us truly feel at home. This experience added an unforgettable touch to our trip. I would highly recommend it and will definitely choose this place again in the future.

Çok güzel ve keyifli bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli, konforlu ve ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şey düşünülmüş. Kendimi kendi evimde gibi rahat hissettim. Konumu da oldukça güzel ve sakin. Ev sahibi ilgili, güler yüzlü ve yardımseverdi. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederim. Kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğim ve gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Öncelikle belirtmek isterim ki haftasonu konaklamamıza rağmen çok sessiz ve huzurlu bir ortam vardı. Her şey fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi. Ev gayet düzenli ve temizdi. Tuğba hanımla tanışma fırsatımız olmadı ama asistanı Begüm Hanım bizimle çok güzel ilgilendi.
Tuğba Hanım ile de telefondan sürekli iletişim halindeydik. İkisine de çok teşekkür ediyorum. Biz kız arkadaşımla çok memnun kaldık. Mutlaka tekrar geleceğiz. Ayrıca kedisi Pamuk'ta çok güzel ve akıllı bir kedi , kedi fobiniz yoksa kesinlikle çekinmenize gerek yok.

Tuğba is such a nice host !
Very helpful and very kind.
She has managed to advise me best places around, location is perfect.
Few minutes to the beach and to Aqua Florya, all within walking distance.
The apartment, really is amazing with a very unique and beautiful style, as well as the rooftop terrace. Definitely, whenever in Istanbul it will be my place to be.
Thanks Tuğba !
Evin konumu güzel , ev büyük ve temiz ve ev sahibesi çok anlayışlı

description:
‘’Pashas House No:3'' is in the Third Floor.Private Apartment with 2Bedrooms, 1Kitchen, 1Bathroom. Our Apartment is nearly too all Major attractions.
Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Santa Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Cisterns are in 10 Minutes Walk Distance.

reviews.text: I travelled on my own with my eight year old daughter. This place has proven to be the right choice! The apartment is exactly as seen in the photos. The bed and the sofa are comfortable, the room is spacious, the shower is very good and the TV has several resources. Wifi works ok. Location was great for us. 10 minutes from TRAM and Grand Bazaar, 10/15 minutes easy walk from Blue Mosque and Aya Sofia. Only a few stations by tram away from Eminonu and Galata Bridge, where we took the boat for the Bosphorus tour and to go to places like Kabatas. And a couple of stations from Sultanahmed if you prefer to go by tram. The neighbourhood is more residential, so quiet at night, and we had no problems sleeping at all. I felt safe in the area and had no problems at all going back walking at night, which we did most of the days. Supermarket, small shops for groceries, bank, all just a minute away. There is a street less than five minutes walking with many, many restaurants to choose from. Including one that also belongs to Barbaros and has very reasonable prices and good food. It's worth a visit as there is live turkish music in some restaurants and it can be a good glimpse of local life. Great if you love sea food but there are other options too. For us, the highlight with this apartment was Ali, who manages the apartments. He was waiting for us on arrival, was very helpful with the lugagge and in showing the apartment itself, and the area around. He made himself available, gave us all his contact numbers, and a card explaining in turkish how to get to the apartment. Very handy to use if you take a taxi. And it is easy to reach him if you need , as he works in the same building. Nothing seemed too much trouble for him, and he antecipated my needs. For example, he gave me a trasnport card so I didn't need to buy one ( only charge with some credit), gave us a map marking all the areas of interest and showed us how to get around. One day I asked where to go for a typical Turkish breakfast and a couple of days later he brought us some Borek from the best shop in the area, and juices for breakfast. Still, Ali was very professional and not invasive at all. He was also helpful giving tips on where to get things we wanted, and booking transport back to the airport. He waited with us to make sure the taxi was coming and helped with the lugagge too. I really appreciated his support as it made me feel safe in case I needed any help or back up, being so far from home with my daughter. We also met Barbaros at his restaurant, and he was friendly and helpful too, always asking how was everything and...

We really enjoyed staying at this apartment. The kitchen had many amenities, there was a washing machine, drying rack, iron, air conditioners in the main room and the bedroom. The space was comfortable and definitely worth the price.
Even though it’s located on a busy street, you can’t hear much from the 3rd floor. Kubilay is so helpful. He made check in/out smooth and he was available to help always. I would stay here again just because of him to be honest. He is a good guide, helped call a taxi for us and had good food recommendations (ask him about the bakery down the street).
It was easy to catch a taxi from the road here and there is also a taxi hub not far. The metro was about a 5-7 minute walk. Overall, a good area if you want to be around Sultanahmet but also take the metro to other parts of Istanbul.
When you first get here, make sure to follow the address to the House, not the Group. The apartments are located at the base of the colorful long stairs.

This was a great place to stay while we explored the Sultanahmet area. The place was clean and as described and for the money, unbeatable value. The restaurant right downstairs is a small home kitchen which worked great for a meal in a pinch. There's a decent amount of stairs and incline for this place so be aware of that (nothing crazy). Thank you for the great stay.

We stayed 10 days. The location is excellent horizontally, a bit challenging vertically. I mean, it's within 15-20 minutes walk to all the major Sultanahmet sites or the Grand Bazaar, but everything is up a steep hill from here, and this unit is on the third floor (= 3.5 to 4th floor in the American system), so be sure you don't mind stairs and hills. Host Barbaros is responsive by phone/text, but is a hands-off host: We never met him. Check-in, requests for supplies, etc. were handled by his assistant, Anna, who is very helpful and friendly, although she does not speak English. There are a few minor repairs, mostly cosmetic, that would help polish the place up, but the kitchen is well-equipped and all the important things in the apartment worked properly (air con, shower, 3 of 4 burners on the stove, all the lights, etc.). Double-pane windows do a good job keeping out street and mosque sounds, and a nice new feature is a clothes washer right in the apartment. This was a good, comfortable base for our 10 days in Istanbul.

The host met us at the apartment and made us feel very welcome. He supplied very good information about the sites to see in Istanbul. The apartment was great. It was nicely furnished. very comfortable, clean and had the best shower we had on our trip. The location was good and within walking distance of all the major tourist sites and the metro.

description: Spend a peaceful holiday in this sunny house next to the Galata Tower, where you will feel the historical texture of Galata.

reviews.text: We had a great time in Galata! The flat is just as it is in the photos. Emine was a great host and always available. Check in was really easy and there was even some snacks, coffee and water when we arrived. As others have mentioned, there was a strong damp smell but with some ventilation it was ok. Galata is a lively neighborhood so not the place if you want an early night but an amazing place to explore close to the water and all the major attractions.

Emine is a wonderful host, and the apartment is fantastic! The location is perfect if you enjoy walking rather than relying on public transport. The space is clean and well-equipped, with everything you might need. One of the highlights is the view of Galata Tower from the window, along with a cozy spot to relax with a glass of wine, watch the street life, or simply unwind. Emine was very responsive and helpful, making communication easy and pleasant. We felt safe and completely at home—I highly recommend staying here!
No hot water. Apartment was very cold. No heater.

I really enjoyed my stay at this house and especially the location that is close to nice places in istanbul and touristic also.
The host is so gentile and comprehensive , flexible and friendly. Grateful for this stay!

A wonderful place right in the center of Istanbul! Restaurants, shops, and public transportation are all within walking distance. The apartment is very cozy and warm, and it has everything you need.
The owner left us New Year gifts in the form of souvenirs, which was very thoughtful!
It would be nice to have more cookware (pots, larger bowls)

description:
Fantastic apartment in the heart of Besiktas, right next to tourist attractions! In this home where modern comfort and elegance converge, you are just one step away from the heartbeat of the city. Explore the symbols of Istanbul, savor the atmosphere of cafes and markets. Immerse yourself in the city's dynamism, perfect for a comfortable stay.

-Perfectly isolated chat atmosphere
-Cozy and compact space
-A magnificent Bosphorus view.

reviews.text:
The host shared the location details and photos of the house in detail on the day of our check-in, which made it easy to find the place. However, the lockbox where you collect the key was jammed both during check-in and check-out. We had to spend around 20 minutes trying to open it upon arrival. Apparently, the key can sometimes get stuck inside the lock, and to fix it, you need to hit or shake the lock firmly. When we informed the host about this issue, they told us they would replace the lock as soon as possible.
The house was very clean and had everything you could possibly need. We didn’t experience any problems at all. And the view — words simply aren't enough to describe it. It was amazing. All the furniture was clean and well-organized. There were plenty of towels, extra linens, and blankets.
I would only advise against it if you have leg problems or are traveling with an elderly person, as the apartment is on the top floor and there are quite a few stairs to climb.

I stayed 18 days at Flex's listing and there are some good aspects and some not so good. The main attraction to the listing is the view, which is great but there were problems with most of the windows not opening and most of the blinds not working (stuck/broken), so you get a partial view. One of the blinds fell down the second day and the team did come take a look but didn't bother reaching out after that. The shower head was leaking which was quickly replaced but replaced with another shower head which also leaked. Kitchen is well stocked but the stove is under powered. The only appliance that seems to work well was the washing machine.
Pros:
1. View
2. Location
3 . Quiet
Cons:
1. Broken blinds
2. Worn out sofa with cigarette burns and wobbly dinning table chairs.
3. Kitchen stove is not for cooking, mostly for making a sandwich at best.
4. Price for value not worth it.
5. Stairs can be an issue if you have bad knees or you require assistance.

We stated here with our family for our trip in Istanbul, we chose this place as we were attending a wedding near by. The location is perfect, you can be next to the sea just by a 6 minutes walk. Although the building is situated on a hill, it is not very difficult to access, thanks to the stair on the street. There is a Market next to the building where you can buy most of your needs and a very close bakery with delicious Turkish savory.
The host was extremely proactive with the communication and very helpful to ensure a great stay.
The sofa in the living room is very large and comfortable to sleep too, if you are staying with the whole family.
+++the view! You will witness the most incredible view of Bosphorus from the apartment, especially in the evening, it is just magical.
As a person who used to live in Istanbul, I found it refreshing to be able to walk anywhere without a need of taxi.
Definitely recommended!

The view is absolutely stunning and the main reason we booked this place. However, several issues affected our stay.
1. On the second day, an electrician cut the power due to unpaid bills. It was restored later that night after we contacted the host.
2. The fridge was broken, the freezer door stuck open, and it made loud noise, so we had to switch it off at night.
3. The locks on the large windows were broken, creating a serious security risk since someone could access the terrace from the adjacent building.
4. The second bedroom has no window, so there’s no ventilation.
5. No elevator (mentioned in the listing) and the unit is on the first floor.
6. The mattress and bedding were poor quality and uncomfortable.
Pros:
The incredible Bosphorus and bridge view is the highlight and the reason the stay didn’t feel like a total loss.

He is charging for the people fees without staying any night because if you are human you can’t stay in that miserable place even Airbnb they not roughness to me to refund my payment totally which I’m feeling very bad impression against them and by this it will impact their reputation
Finally this first and last time I had to deal with that bad App

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located, quiet place.

About this place
Stylish and modern living space in Taksim and Cihangir, the heart of Istanbul. This centrally located house is next to Istiklal Avenue. You will feel as peaceful as at home in the most prestigious area of Istanbul
you will feel.
Bright and spacious apartment with 1 bedroom.

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Kaan’s apartment! The place is exactly as described; clean, spacious and cozy. The location is perfect, close to Istiklal Street and many nice cafés and shops, yet very quiet and peaceful.
Kaan is an amazing host. Highly recommend!

Evin ulaşımı ve konumu çok merkezi ve rahattı. eve giriş son derece kolaydı. güvenlik anlamında da son derece rahattı. evin içinde temel ihtiyaç malzemeleri mevcuttu. temizlik konusunda da herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. evin yakınında otopark imkanının olması da başka bir avantajdı. Kaan bey yardımsever ve hızlı dönüş yapan bir ev sahibi. çok memnun olarak ayrıldığımız bi konaklamaydı

The apartment was excellent, very clean and comfortable. The location is perfect, close to Taksim Square with everything you need nearby. The host was always available, responsive, and very helpful at any time. I really felt like I was at home. Highly recommended!

The worst Airbnb I’ve ever had, the host and co-host didn’t reply at all I was waiting for 2 hours ,the apartment was bit dirty and no hot shower and the apartment is super cold
I don’t recommend to choose this place.

Evin yeri çok güzel dairenin içi tertemiz mutfak eşyaları temiz banyo tertemiz yastık kılıflarından tutun yatak örtüleri çarşaflar vs hepsi tertemizdi fotoğraflarla birebir aynı zaten konaklama yapmaktan hiç şüpheniz olmasın ev sahibi de herhangi bir sorunuz olduğunda hemen yardımcı oluyor

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Really smooth communication with the host who helped us arrange a transfer to the airport during the night for a reasonable price. The rooms are slightly smaller than on the pictures but it’s clean and well located: near to the center but without the crowd and the noise. Highly recommended.

The place is located on a very steep hill, and it’s almost impossible to reach by car. If you have luggage, be prepared to drag it up the hill. It’s definitely not a stroller-friendly area and feels unsafe, as motorcycles speed by in all directions with no control or respect for pedestrians.
The apartment itself was not as clean as expected. There was a strong, unpleasant sewage smell, stains on the bed sheets, and even some items left behind from the previous guest in the bathroom. The shower is extremely small — I’m not a large person, but I kept bumping into the walls just trying to wash my hair.
I understand that many buildings in Istanbul are old and don’t have elevators, but it’s something to seriously consider if you’re traveling with luggage.
We had originally booked for two nights but ended up leaving after the first night and booking another place instead.
That being said, Omar was very responsible and helpful — he responded quickly and did his best to assist us throughou

Omer was very helpful and accommodating. We checked in late, and he was there to welcome us and even helped carry our luggage upstairs. He also arranged an airport transfer for €50, which was convenient. The property is in a great location, close to the Grand Bazaar.
Overall, we had a good stay and felt it was worth the cost. However, the place looks more beautiful in the pictures than it does in reality. The room is quite small, there is no exhaust fan in the bathroom, and the bathroom window faces another building, so people outside can potentially see inside.
Despite these drawbacks, the location, helpful host, and reasonable price made it a good overall experience.

Wow! One of the best Airbnbs we have stayed in and we have stayed in about 14 airbnbs in the last 10 months. The host was very kind to let us check in early with our luggages. The room was spotless, very clean. Everything is exactly like the photos. They left us some cold water bottles so that was lovely. I always appreciate when there is water in the fridge after a long day of travel. We decided to stay 2 more nights so we got in contact with the host and he gave us a discount which we really appreciate. There is Netflix available and I cannot find any fault with this place. Thank you so much Ömer for hosting us. We really enjoyed our stay.

We had a really great stay here! The location was perfect, with easy access to all the major attractions and local markets, which saved us a lot of travel time and gave us much more flexibility during our trip.
The room was spacious, comfortable, and had everything that was mentioned in the Airbnb listing. Omer was also a fantastic host very helpful, quick to respond, and always happy to assist whenever we needed anything.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend this place to our friends and anyone reading this review. 100% value for money! He also booked the airport return for us from the location, which was convenient for us.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: The small apartment is within walking distance in a lively area and just a few minutes' walk from the harbor. There are many cafes and restaurants nearby. Communication with Murat regarding check-in and check-out went smoothly. Some questions went unanswered, with the explanation that they were dealing with too many messages from other apartments. The apartment was generally clean. The shower could only be set to lukewarm water using the water heater. There was black mold in the shower. The apartment was very cold in February (the windows didn't seal well), and the small electric heater provided little relief. Provided these issues are addressed, the small apartment would be suitable for a few nights in Istanbul.
Her şey harikaydı! Ev fotoğraflardakiyle birebir aynıydı, Temizlik çok iyiydi, konum merkeziydi ve ev sahibi oldukça ilgiliydi. Konaklamamız boyunca kendimizi çok rahat ve güvende hissettik.

We, my husband and I, were very disappointed with this apartment.
On check-in, it wasnt cleaned properly— a cleaner was sent, but then the problems began: no light in the room, a broken shower head leaking from the hose,- impossible to take shower, a sink leaking onto the rug, and even a coffee cup with a broken handle. When I reported it, the host’s reply was unbelievable: “It’s not a Hilton to expect everything perfect, we cannot check after each guest.” It says alot.
He offered another room. At first it looked fine, but the cleaner warned the AC was leaking and “would be fixed later.” Nobody came. That night water started dripping right above the bathroom and entrance doors — I had to lay towels in the narrow path to avoid puddles.
We didn’t move only because one day was left. And note: these “apartments” are tiny, more like small hotel rooms.
Broken facilities, leaks, dismissive host, cramped space — this stay spoiled our last three days in Turkey. Absolutely not recommended

A beautiful, tall townhouse with a stunning staircase. The location is very peaceful, yet it’s just a short walk to many wonderful cafes and restaurants. The apartment was cozy, comfortable, and beautifully decorated – it had everything I needed. The hosts are very communicative and helpful. Special thanks to Ms. Daria, who was so kind and helped me with the laundry facilities available in the building. Highly recommended!

The host was very responsive and flexible regarding the check-in time. Additionally, the location was superb—it’s literally less than a 5-minute walk to the gorgeous sea. However, one issue was the availability of hot water in the shower. Other than that, I had a pleasant stay here.

description: A modern decorated duplex in a newly renovated historical building self check in is available. Upto 10 people can sleep. Located in a friendly neighborhood and 5 mins walking to Istiklal Street the most vivid district of Istanbul, 15 mins to Taksim and Galata Tower 4 rooms with 2 kitchens equipped with washing machines and fridges. There're 2 queen sized beds and 3 sofas that can turn into bed. The flat have a separate and heater system and air condition in all rooms. Free Wifi, 50 Mbps.

reviews.text: The whole home was unbelievably dirty and there was mould on the walls. The headboards of the bed had stains on them and i doubt the sheets were actually washed. The shower had dirt in it and it stank. The kettle was missing its lid and there were tiles that were cracked. It was atrocious. We requested to be refunded which we were but not for 2 nights even though we stayed for about 4 hours. If you’re looking for a place to ruin your trip, by all means go here. The only positive thing was the host agreed to refund us. AVOID.

Ev ilanda belirtilen gibi değildi, her odada klima olduğu söyleniyordu fakat sadece alt kattaki çalışıyordu, üst kattakilerden birinin kumandası yoktu ve diğeri de çalışıyor gibi gözüküp sadece ılık hava üflüyordu; kapı şifresinin olduğu yerden sürekli rahatsız edici bir ses geliyordu ve pencerelerin de korumalığı yok. Bulunduğu konum inanılmaz kötü İstiklal'e yakın fakat en tehlikeli mahallelerden biri bu sebepten cam da açamadım ilk gece hiç uyuyamadım. Ayrıca evin bulunduğu yerde çok yokuş var valizlerle bu çok zorluk çıkardı. Bu sebeplerden ilk gecenin sabahında çıkmak zorunda kaldık ev sahibi ilk gece dışında kalan ücreti iade etti. Fakat unuttuğum ayakkabımı temizlik personeli atmış ev sahibi ücreti göndereceğini söyledi, ayakkabının kendi ücretinin yarısını gönderdi ve beni paragöz olmakla suçladı. İstanbul'un en tehlikeli mahallelerinden birinde berbat bir gece geçirmek ve değerli eşyalarınızın atılmasını istiyorsanız buyrun gelin

Evin konumu güzeldi, park sorunu yaşadık, marketlere çok yakın, 2 yatak odası ve 1 oturma odası mevcut, kanepeler dahil 10 kişi kalabilir, toplamda 2 yatak 3 açılabilir L koltuk vardı. Çarşaf ve yorganlar biraz daha temiz olabilir. Tam olarak fiyat performans evi genel olarak beğendik.

On the positives I have to mention how responsive and efficient the host was. They were fast to respond to all our questions and this made our stay more comfortable. On the other side there were quite a lot of negative aspects that outweigh the host's responsiveness I'm afraid. The property was really tired and needed urgent renovation. There was dump and humidity accros all rooms with visible stains on the walls. The bed linens and towels did not feel clean or fresh and we also found hair on some. The sofas had also quite a lot of stains which made the experience a little bit uncomfortable. I think if they focused on cleanliness a bit more the whole experience would have been far more pleasant. Although We did enjoy our stay and we thank the host for their care!

Konumu çok güzel Taksime, Sultanahmet gibi tarihi yerlere çok yakın. Fotoğraflarda gözükdüğü gibi. Ev sahibi Ercüment Bey sorulara hızlı cevap veriyor kendisine teşekkür ediyoruz, herkese tavsiye ederiz.

description:
Modern and luxurious loft suite with interior architectural design. There is a bathtub & extra bathroom for you to relieve the tiredness of the day and relax. Our guests will be able to enjoy the stars from our sky window while relaxing in the bathtub. Our suite is located in our hotel, which has hotel apartments, located in the center of Şişli, just 1 min walk from the main street.
This suite is located on the rooftop of the hotel and the entire floor belongs only for this romantic King Suite.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive and helpful, which made everything smooth and stress-free. The location was great, and we’d happily stay here again.

“A complete disaster! I never expected such a terrible experience. First of all, the address provided was completely incorrect. When I arrived at the given location, I was told the actual address was 20 minutes away, forcing me to walk in the rain to get there. This was already a terrible start.
When I finally arrived, things only got worse. The towels provided were dirty, had hair on them and there wasn’t even a proper place to hang them. Basic necessities like soap and shampoo were also missing, making the stay extremely inconvenient. The place lacked even the most basic hygiene and comfort essentials, with not enough towels, sheets, or cleaning supplies provided. The property looked nothing like the photos or description.
On top of all that, the noise in the building was unbearable. It was impossible to rest because of constant loud sounds. Other guests in the building, particularly a group who appeared to be of Arab descent, were extremely noisy and inconsiderate.

Konumu çok güzeldi, odalar temiz ve düzenliydi. Çalışanlar da oldukça ilgili ve yardımseverdi, kendimizi rahat hissettik. Özellikle ulaşım açısından çok avantajlı bir yerdeydi ve konaklamamız genel olarak çok keyifli geçti. Sadece otopark konusunda biraz zorlandık çünkü park yeri bulmak kolay değildi. Onun dışında memnun kaldığımız bir deneyimdi, tekrar tercih edebiliriz 😊

Herşey sorunsuz ilerliyordu daire fotoğraftakinden daha küçüktü ama bu bizim için büyük bir sorun oluşturmadı ancak dairenin duşunda ve küvetinde gelen su çok ama çok kısıtlıydı küvetin dolması 1 saat sürüyordu sıcak su bazen hiç gelmiyordu bunların yanı sıra bu durumu ev sahibi ile paylaştığımızda ise sorunsuz bir şekilde iletişim kurdu ama sonrasında daireye binada görevli olan ev sahibi veya bir başkası bilmiyorum ama daire ile sorumlu olan bir kisiydi bana sert bir tavırla size ücretinizin %10’unu iade edelim ve sizde çıkın denildi biz sadece sorunlar olduğunu ve bu sorunların çözülmesi için taleplerde bulunduğumuzu söyledik ama kişi çıkmamız konusunda baya ısrarcıydı ve yaklaşık müsait olmamamıza rağmen durumu düzeltip daireden çıkmamak için 15 dakika boyunca daireye gelen kisi ile sert ilerleyen bir konuşmayı yumşatıp konuyu kapatmak istedik ama sonrasında gece geç saatte gelip kapıyı çok sert vurup bizi çok ses çıkartıyorsunuz diye uyardılar ama biz uyuyorduk ses çıkarmamıza bir

Konser için 1 gecelik konaklama yaptım ama açık söyleyeyim, İstanbul’da bundan sonra daha uzun süreli konaklamalarda tercih edeceğim favorilerim arasına girdi. Oda inanılmaz temizdi; çarşaflar, yastıklar, banyo… her yer tertemiz ve hijyen kokuyordu. Şehrin tam merkezinde olmasına rağmen ortam son derece sakin, şehir gürültüsünden tamamen uzak bir konumdaydı.
Sadece klima biraz daha sessiz çalışsa ve su akışı biraz daha güçlü olsa mükemmel ötesi olurdu ama bunlar genel deneyimimi etkilemedi. Her şeye rağmen 10 üzerinden 10 veriyorum. Verdiğiniz paranın karşılığını fazlasıyla hak eden bir işletme. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim!

description: Our house, which is a 3-minute walk from Taksim, offers a comfortable stay in the city center. You can reach the tram, metro, bus and ferry in just a few steps. The single bedroom has a double bed and the living room has a sofa bed that can be a double bed. The house is suitable for families and accommodates up to 4 people. The kitchen is equipped with all the equipment to meet your daily needs. Ideal for those looking for a central and peaceful environment. There is a grocery store and a market in the neighborhood.

reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay at this Airbnb! The location is incredibly convenient, just a 3-minute walk from Taksim Square and right next to a supermarket, fruit shops, and plenty of delicious restaurants. The host, Tuana, was very kind and helpful, especially with directions and clear check-in instructions. We arrived earlier than expected and she arranged an early check-in for us at 12:30, which we really appreciated.
The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well-spaced for two people. It’s on the ground floor, which makes it easy to access with no stairs. The only small downside is that it doesn’t get much natural sunlight, but overall it was a great stay and excellent value. Would definitely recommend!

We booked a few hours before check in and Tuana was very quick to help us out (as our planned accommodation was a scam). The flat had everything we needed. Worth mentioning that the it's by a flight of street stairs, so the natural light and ventilation in the bedroom was not that easy when it rained. But the AC worked wonders and we were out exploring the city most of the time anyway. There is parking nearby and a small market. Very close to Taksim square, which makes it very well connected. Overall, great experience and great host!

We had a fantastic stay here, the location could not be better: right at Taksim Square. Walk up to the metro, buses or Istiklal Cd., take the funicular to the ferries or walk down to lots of café's, shops & restaurants and to the tramway (to Sultanahmet). The host was great, very fast in responding to questions, and very helpful. The apartment was excellent, clean and very well organized, and it had everything you could possibly need, even an ironing board and iron, and home slippers for everybody. The kitchen also has extra's, we found the French press very useful for our first morning coffee. One of the best things for us was the shower, very roomy and a forceful hot water stream, which was the best after a day of site-seeing.
Right under the building is a very useful little supermarket which we used every day. Around the corner is a liquor store with a variety of beer (and stronger).
All in all highly recommended!

My apt. is located on the 1st flr, hse no 1. I really like this house, it's comfortable, complete with minimalist furniture, there's a washing machine and dryer, there's an iron and ironing board but I don't use the iron because the sole is rusty and not good to use because it has the potential to scorch our clothes 🤪, there's a kitchen and kitchen utensils to cook our food, there's a broom and floor mop that we can use at any time we need. The atmosphere and layout of the house and bedroom as well as the living room and kitchen make me feel like I'm at home.
Just a few improvements, maybe need to add 1 slightly larger pan to cook food if possible, and maintenance needs to be done regularly to prevent the sink and bathroom holes from getting clogged because the water flow is quite slow. The shower head and hose also need to be replaced because it's torn and more water comes out of the hose than the shower head itself. Apart from that, the location of this house is very close to Taksim

We enjoyed our stay at Merve’s place in Taksim. The location couldn’t be better, just a few minutes’ walk from the metro, buses, and the Havaist shuttle from the airport. Super convenient for getting around!
Merve has done a great job making the apartment feel comfortable and welcoming. Everything was clean, the furniture was in great shape, and she left clear instructions for everything we needed. She was always quick to respond and super helpful, she even arranged our airport transfer in a comfy VIP VITO van, which made things so much easier.
Just a small note: the apartment is at the bottom of a hill, so be ready for a bit of a climb if you’re heading up to Taksim Square. It didn’t bother us, but it’s good to know.

description: From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. Our place, designed for large groups to spend their vacation both economically and comfortably, is ready to offer you everything you need.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Gökhan’s place. The accommodation was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed for a pleasant stay. Communication was excellent throughout, and Gökhan was friendly, responsive, and helpful whenever needed. The location was convenient and made it easy to explore the area. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to other guests.
great place everything is clean and as described and the host is so friendly and responsive definitely worth it

We had a very pleasant stay at this place. The house was comfortable, clean, and well located. The host was friendly and responsive, and the check-in process was easy. We really appreciated the peaceful atmosphere and the overall experience.
Thank you for hosting us. We would happily stay here again and recommend it to other guests.

Gokan was an amazing host always kept checking up asking if we needed anything. House was clean and felt right at home. Locals stores are close from markets to little restaurants don’t have to walk far. I definitely recommend this place if you are a group or even alone just great a great host that will make sure you are comfortable and have everything you need. Thank you Gokhan I will definitely be booking again for my next visit!

Bizim için gerçekten güzel bir deneyim oldu.Ev çok rahattı sabahları yataktan kalkasım gelmedi.Ev genel olarak temizdi ferahtı herhangi bir sorun yoktu.Memnun kaldık.Dubleks olması da güzeldi.Konumu bulması kolay taksime yakın bir konumda ama taksimin genel yapısı itibariyle gece geç girişte biraz korktuk ancak hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık.Ev sahibi gerek girmeden önce gerek girdikten sonra bizimle iletişimde kaldı biz yazmasak bile bir eksiğimiz var mı yok mu kendi yazdı kendisine teşekkür ediyorum.Özetle gayet temiz rahat konforlu güzel bir evdi.Taksim tarafında kalmayı düşünüyorsanız çok iyi bir seçenek

description:
Stylish 4BR Duplex in Cihangir – Walk to everywhere

Stay in a beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom ground-floor duplex in trendy Cihangir, Istanbul. Steps from cafes, shops, and restaurants. Walk to Taksim Square, Istiklal, Galata Tower, and Galataport. Easy tram access to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque & Topkapi. Perfect for families & groups in a safe, central neighborhood!

reviews.text:
We stayed in two properties in the area, and the neighborhood is simply unbeatable if you are visiting Istanbul. It’s close to public transportation and all the major tourist sites. The vibe is very eclectic, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, art boutiques, and antique shops—full of character and charm.
The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos: beautifully decorated, very clean, and with comfortable beds. The décor perfectly reflects the atmosphere of the neighborhood and the spirit of old Istanbul.
The host was amazing. On our last night, we had an issue with another property and had to move out. He kindly welcomed us very late at night, took the time to explain everything, and even allowed us a late check-out.
We truly appreciated the hospitality and would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful time staying here, the apartment was just as described; well decorated and clean & in a perfect location. It was a great base for exploring Istanbul and near a number of local amenities.
Host was very accommodating, check-in was flexible and easy, and they kept in contact to ensure all was well and even gave some great recommendations for places to visit and eat. I would definitely recommend.

The place is as pictured. The host is attentive and helpful. The neighbourhood is very nice (but expensive!)
Only thing is the sheets are quite scratchy and beds not so comfortable (other than the master bedroom, which was soft and comfortable)
I would recommend to stay here :)

From before we arrived and during the stay communication was amazing. Check in was very simple and Elif gave us great tips on near by food spots. The apartment was very clean and super comfortable for our group. The location was amazing and close to so many great places but also walkable to the tram and metro.
I would highly recommend for anyone to stay there. And if I’m in Istanbul again I will check to see if apartment is available.

Incredible place! There were four of us and we each had our own room with large, comfortable beds. The shower pressure and temperature was great.
Elif was extremely helpful and communicative throughout our stay, checking in periodically to make sure everything was okay and responding quickly whenever we had a question.
The apartment is located in Cihangir which is my favorite area of Istanbul. It's walkable, lively, and full of great cafés, but still relaxed at night.
Would absolutely stay here again!

description:
Our spacious studio, suitable for families and groups of friends, offers comfortable accommodation for up to 3 people.

Thanks to the private kitchen, you can have an economical and comfortable stay. Thanks to its central location, it provides easy access to historical places and public transportation.

✔️ Accommodation for 3 people
✔️ Private kitchen
✔️ Air conditioning & heating
✔️ Free Wi-Fi
✔️ Close to tourist attractions

Comfort and location together.

reviews.text:
Incredibly affordable room within walking distance to a lot of the European side's landmarks like the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Incredibly close to a lot of small stores and restaurants and also located centrally to train stations and ports for easy commutes.
The room offered large and comfortable beds, was incredibly clean and some free drinks were provided.
Check-in was lenient with Tuncay waiting an extra hour at reception for us due to flight delays and checkout was fairly easy if you knock on the door at the bottom of the stairs.
There were also friendly cats frequently sleeping right outside of the apartment for any cat lovers

We stayed 4 nights here and for the value it was a great deal. Looked just like the photos, in a walkable distance from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia (20 mins), and close to bus/tram lines (10 mins). I would be mindful for anyone with mobility issues as it is a steeper climb to get to the central area. Many restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores nearby. Located in a quiet and safe area, there was no noise at all during the evening. Bathroom could use brighter lighting, it was dimly lit. The man at the reception and Tuncay were helpful and responsive in case we needed anything. I would recommend this place

This is a nice comfortable room, with everything you need. AC works well, hot water and location is very quiet at night. Perfect for sleeping. However, please note that this is not a hotel and there is no lobby. It is an apart building. The name of the apart, which seems to be Amida Family Apart was never mentioned in the ad, nor was it given to us before arriving. We also had no photo of the exterior, so it was hard to find and a bit confusing even when someone opened the door. Its a run down street, looks a bit rough from the outside but Once you're there, you realize its not far from the busy streets and appreciate the quiet sector.

We were truly satisfied with our stay!
The house was clean and comfortable, with a convenient cleaning service every morning upon request. The location is perfect, very close to all the main attractions. The owner and staff were incredibly kind and helpful. We really enjoyed our experience and would definitely recommend this place!

Everything was perfect! The apartment is very clean, comfortable, and has a great location. Tuncay is an amazing and helpful host. We really enjoyed our stay in Istanbul and highly recommend this place!

description: Stay in the heart of Beşiktaş and enjoy a peaceful getaway! This stylish 1-bedroom apartment is just 10 minutes’ walk to major tourist attractions and only 3 minutes from vibrant bars and restaurants. With a balcony overlooking a serene garden, it offers the perfect balance of central location and tranquility. Fully equipped with modern comforts, this apartment is ideal for an unforgettable Istanbul experience.

reviews.text:
Pros:
- Location: right in Besiktas center so accessible to cafes etc; 20-25min walk to Nisantasi; 10min walk to piers to the Anatonian side
- Communication: generally responsive except about check-out
- Style: Comfortable for one person
Cons:
- Cleanliness: smelly and watery at the entrance, lots of flyers and the likes at the door (but landlord did arrange cleaning upon request), dirty laundry machine
- Noise: apartment is on a side street but can still hear noises from trucks/ passerby on some nights, or movements from neighbours upstairs.
- Amenities: Stove wasn't working and lighter provided didn't always work. Bedroom curtain couldn't cover the whole window, which faces the main side street. Toilet didn't flush properly. Bedroom could be hot in the summer.
- Size: Good for one person but smaller than expected. Balcony is tiny, even without a table outside.
- Disagreements on check-out arrangements despite re-confirmation.
More suitable for a short stay, instead of my 19 nights

The listing was as described except for some unexpected hiccups with heating system and shower (not the host’s fault). Our host responded quick enough and we were able to accommodate well. It’s an experience for us and we do appreciate all the help given.
We took HAVAIST bus from the airport and it dropped us at Besiktas square. It took us 20-25 mins on cobblestone walk with two big luggage bags. It should be easier if not with the luggage bags.
The listing is surrounded with restaurants and shops, with approximately 10 mins walk to the bus stop. It is very convenient even for first time travelers.

Ev genel olarak temizdi fotoğraflarda gösterilen her şey yerli yerindeydi sadece eksi sayabileceğim 3 şey var biri çekyat çok sağlıklı durmuyordu diğeri ise banyo biraz daha iyi olabilirdi duş başlığı biraz paslıydı ve duşa kabinin bir kapağı yoktu son olarakta otopark sorunu en önemlisi bu bence en az 20dk park yeri arıyorsunuz onun harici gayet güzel rahat ve temiz bir ev gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilirsiniz

Unfortunately the place was not clean at all. Even the loo had not been cleaned.
Host explained it was due to previous guest.
We could arrange for a refund with host easily which was great. We moved to a nearby hotel that was very clean for a similar price.

Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi gayet düzenli ve temiz bir daire. Konum olarak Beşiktaş meydana ve restoran-cafelere yakın ama Beşiktaş'ın gürültüsünden uzak. Soğuk bir havada konaklamama rağmen dairenin ısıtması çok iyiydi. Ev sahipleri Handan Hanım ve Emre Bey de kısa sürede iletişime geçiyor.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Rojhat’s place. The communication was fast and very helpful, making check-in and check-out extremely smooth. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect — close to transport, shops, and major attractions. Overall, a great experience, and I would definitely stay here again. Thank you, Rojhat!

I had a wonderful experience staying in this cozy studio. I initially booked for 10 nights but ended up extending my stay by 3 additional days because of how comfortable and convenient everything was. The location is ideal within walking distance of the market, the sea, and public transportation, and situated in a safe, quiet area. The studio was exceptionally clean and well maintained. Communication with the host was seamless; he was consistently available and accommodating. I was especially grateful for his generosity in offering a complimentary late check-out to match my flight schedule. As a fellow host with an apartment in Agadir, Morocco, I truly appreciated his professionalism and learned a lot from his excellent business management. Highly recommended!

We stayed here for 4 nights . Place looks like the photos . Beds were clean and comfortable . We slept well . Walking distance to Blue mosque and tram stop . I would stay here again if i come to Istanbul again .

The house is in a quiet neighborhood, although right under a speakerphone which might annoy some, but generally a good and quiet location adjacent to a park.
Inside it was clean and Rojhat was very friendly and helped us in. You might have a bit of trouble locating the place, just look up "Blue bottle cafe" near Kadirga park.
For those not familiar with the area, keep in mind that most public transport lines are a 10+ minute walk uphill, which could tire some.
The only annoyance we faced was the lack of hot water on a cloudy day, so keep that in mind too.
Overall a very clean and safe place, would recommend.

This apartment had everything we expected. Clean and comfortable and well presented. We liked that the dining table was all set for dinner (if we wanted to eat in) However, it was attached to the Blue Plate restaurant where we sat and enjoyed a drink while the apartment was being cleaned (we arrived early) The owner of the restaurant Aziz, chatted and provided valuable info for our stay. We also ate there and the sea bream was very good. The apartment is situated in the older sector and only 10 minutes walk to the Blue Mosque. 15 minutes if you struggle which my wife does. We had a very comfortable stay.

description:
Experience the charm of a historic, beautifully preserved building while enjoying modern comforts in this spacious 3-bedroom apartment. Ideal for families, groups or business travelers, this home combines the best of both worlds: old-world charm and contemporary amenities.

Tram & Metro Stations & Ferry terminal just a few minutes away, making it easy to explore the city. Close to local shops, cafes, restaurants, and all the best the city has to offer.

reviews.text:
The apartment has a great location, very close to Taksim Square, with easy access to all types of transportation. There are also several supermarkets nearby, which makes daily needs very convenient.
The apartment itself is clean and comfortable. Although the building is old, the apartment is well maintained and suitable for a pleasant stay and family friendly. The rooms are well-sized and provide enough space to feel comfortable throughout the stay.
I want to thank the host was very helpful and responsive. They assisted us a lot during check-in and check-out, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free.
As a small note for improvement, having a microwave in the kitchen would be very helpful. Also, the TV is not a smart TV, and the third room doesn’t have a wardrobe Additionally, the elevator in the building is quite small, which may be something to consider for guests with luggage.

The location is absolutely perfect, right in the heart of everything. The house is exactly as described—bright, comfortable, and with an elevator (a huge bonus since that’s not common in Istanbul!). The host truly went above and beyond. I asked if it was possible to get a few extra spoons and maybe a teapot, and within less than two hours they had bought an entire 36-piece cutlery set for us, along with everything else I needed. Incredible hospitality and responsiveness. Highly recommend!

We stayed here as two couples with one kid and had an absolutely fabulous time! The apartment was amazing—extremely clean, spacious, and super comfortable for all of us. The location is unbeatable—just a 2-minute walk to Taksim Square and only 5 minutes to the subway, which made getting around so easy. The host was incredibly helpful and responsive throughout our stay. Everything was perfect, and we’d definitely love to come back. Highly recommended!
The apartment is very clean and comfortable. The host is very helpful and flexible with check-in and check-out. It’s conveniently located, not far from Taksim, with easy access to transportation.”

The location was excellent and very convenient. The flat was spacious enough for six of us and we felt very comfortable during our stay. The only issue was the flat had not been cleaned properly.
Apart from that we had a good experience overall.

description: Deluxe 2 Bedroom Residence #103 on the 1st , this stunning home offers spacious interiors with a thoughtfully designed separate kitchen, perfect for modern living. Located in the prestigious Nişantaşı neighborhood, Istanbul’s most vibrant and stylish district, this residence combines elegance, comfort, and convenience,

reviews.text:
This place is truly exceptional. As a Superhost managing more than 20 apartments, I have high standards for hospitality, and this stay exceeded them.
Traveling with a toddler and a 7-year-old, an apartment was the best option for us. The host was accommodating and helpful from the beginning. The apartment has two separate bedrooms with queen-size beds, one bathroom, a small kitchen, and a comfortable layout. The kitchen could use some upgrades, but it was sufficient, and the host was happy to provide anything we needed. The clean bathroom included a washer and dryer, and the elevator worked perfectly—especially important with a stroller.
The receptionist was outstanding. Although I don’t remember his name, the gentleman with the mustache provided five-star concierge-level service. His professionalism and attentiveness were exceptional, and he deserves special recognition.
The building has a stylish, contemporary design. It is located on a very busy street, but we had no issues.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Teşvikiye, Şişli/İstanbul. The location was perfect—just steps away from grocery stores, cafés, bars, restaurants, and a major shopping centre, making everything easily accessible.
The apartment itself was spotless, well-organized, and fully equipped with all the essentials we needed. It had a modern design, plenty of natural light, and gave a warm, home-like feeling that made our stay even more comfortable.
The host and staff were extremely friendly, welcoming, and helpful, always ready to assist with anything we needed.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul—it truly felt like a home away from home!
Great location, clean house, and very helpful and responsive staff! I would stay again!!!
Great stay right in the center! Spacious 2-bedroom with all the amenities we needed. Perfect location and very comfortable.

Clean, modern, big! Everything in order 👌🏻
Perfect location 😍

description:
Welcome to our apartment located in the heart of Istanbul, in the lively and historic neighborhood of Asmalı Mescit.
This is one of the best locations to truly feel and experience the spirit of Istanbul. Just a 30-second walk to Istiklal Avenue, the apartment offers a unique blend of old Istanbul charm and modern convenience.

You can also reach the metro station in 3 minutes on foot, and the iconic Galata Tower is just a 5-minute walk away, making it easy to explore the city.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this cozy one-bedroom apartment in the heart of Istanbul. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a short or long stay - from kitchen essentials to reliable Wi-Fi. The location is excellent, with easy access to shops, cafes, and taxi. Communication with the host was smooth and friendly - they were always responsive and helpful. I’d definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul!

The place is exactly as described. Just be mindful of how much luggage you bring, as the stairs are narrow and there is no direct car access to the property, so you’ll need to walk a short distance. That said, stairs like this are quite common in this area of Istanbul.
The apartment is very cozy, well equipped, and the host is responsive and helpful. The main reason I personally would think about staying here again is the music at night from the nearby bars, Other than that, I think it’s a very nice place to stay.
Perfect in every way (transport , cleanliness , communication , things to do kitchen) except for the noise - I stay from Sat- Thu and the music from the nearby bars was very load

Overall a good stay, the place was very pretty and in a central location (but a very touristy area). Good for a first time visit to Istanbul!
We probably wouldn’t stay again as the pipes were very smelly - it was hard to use the bathroom/shower because it smelled so bad - likely just cause it’s an old building.
Host was great and very responsive!

30 second walk to taxi rank and 30 seconds to main İstiklal shopping area.
The apartment was better than described with quality furniture, bedding and towels.
I will make this my stay every time I visit Istanbul, thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and could have asked for a better location.
I would have given 10 stars if I could
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

description: ou'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

görsellerde göründüğü gibiydi. temiz ve düzenliydi. fiyat performanstı tam
