The location is very convenient, with easy access to public transportation and several restaurants nearby. The property is easy to find, and I had a very pleasant stay. I would be happy to stay there again on my next visit. Highly recommended.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text: The apartment is in very poor condition, and climbing a steep staircase to the third floor might be difficult for some people. On our very first day, we bought a drain cleaner because the water in the shower simply wouldn’t drain—it was clear that no one had done this in a long time. No one had cleaned the vacuum cleaner in a couple of years either. Everything was done haphazardly; all the outlets kept falling out, making them impossible to use. There were two hair dryers in the apartment, and both were broken, so you’d better bring your own. One of them made terrible noises, and the other worked intermittently. There are a lot of ants in the apartment; this is one of the biggest downsides. There are no locks on either bedroom door; in one of them, the door wouldn’t close at all, so we propped it open with a nightstand. The apartment’s location isn’t bad; overall, it was quiet, and we couldn’t hear the neighbors. The host was great—he gave clear instructions and explained everything!

What you see in the pictures is very different from the actual condition of the place. There is no proper ventilation or exhaust fan, & the rooms are extremely hot sometimes it feels like being in a sauna.We stayed for 13 days and had to sleep on the floor because the fans in both rooms were broken, & we were afraid they might fall on us during the night. Every evening when we came back, we had to keep the windows open for about an hour to get rid of the strong and unpleasant smell in the room. The hallway also smelled very bad.The place was also quite dirty. The small couch and rug were so unclean that we did not feel well lying or sleeping on them. Honestly, if I came to Turkey again, I would not pay even $5 a night for this room, because if you cannot sleep comfortably at night, it is simply not worth the money.The host himself was a nice person, and we have no complaints about his behavior. Our concern is only with the condition & cleanliness, and overall quality of accommodation.

We stayed at Mert’s apartment for four nights with our family and had a great experience. The apartment was very clean, well-maintained, and nicely furnished. Its central location made it easy to get around and reach everything we needed. The host was helpful, responsive, and always ready to assist with any questions or issues. Overall, a very comfortable stay — would definitely recommend.

Our stay was wonderful! The host was very responsive and always answered quickly. When we had a small issue with the shower, he immediately sent someone over to fix it, which we really appreciated.
The location was good, although if you take the bus, you’ll need to walk about 10 minutes to reach the place. Overall, we had a great stay and would happily recommend it!

Nice little flat with city views from the bedroom balcony. Easy to reach if you don’t mind walking 15 mins walking from the nearest station.
Definitely good value for money.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Muharrems place was wonderful!! First impressions were very good. The room and bathroom was spotless and very modern compared to other Airbnb’s around the area. There is central heating which was very good considering it was cold during the month i stayed! House keeping cleaned our room everyday which is a first for an airbnb, and i thank the host very much!! Its located close to everything you need , subway , tram, bus stops and walking distance to the main attractions!!All in all its perfect place , great value for money!!! I would definitely stay again!!

We had a lovely stay, the place was very clean and modern, the beds comfy and linen fresh.
We had cold bottles of water waiting for us on arrival in a decent size fridge, there's a kettle and a supply of tea and coffee, but no cooking facilities.
There's a lovely spiral staircase to give you a bit of workout.
You're close to lots of shops, bars, sights and the tram, so a great location.
Everyone was extremely friendly, helpful and flexible.
You could have complimentary tea and coffee each day in the restaurant and 20% off food.
We recommend this place and would stay again.

We had a wonderful time staying at the apartment - the location is perfect, the place was clean and comfortable. Our host Muharrem and his team were brilliant, incredibly helfpul and accommodating. The food at the restaurant downstairs was lovely and we had a great experience. I would highly recommend a stay here!

Muharrem’s place us adhacent/above his restaurant at the quiet end of a street/ neighbourhood full of restaurants.
Just minutes to the water/ferries.
Right ne Sirkeci/Marmaray station ( ideal particularly for SAW airport) and about 12 minute stroll to the blue mosque.
Location is perfect and the apartment clean,modern, quiet and as described.
Easy 5 stars 👍

We had a wonderful stay at Muharrem’s place! From the moment we arrived, we felt truly welcomed. The host provided outstanding service throughout our stay and was incredibly friendly, helpful, and responsive. Everything was well organized, clean, and exactly as described. It’s clear that a lot of care goes into making guests feel comfortable. We really appreciated the warm hospitality and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!

description: Our apartment in the center of Taksim is a triplex. There is a separate bedroom with a double door on each floor. There are 3 double bedrooms on a total of 3 floors. Bathroom on the 1st floor. On the 2nd floor there is a kitchen and everything you need to cook. On the 3rd floor there is a balcony where you can comfortably sit and chat. For the need to wash clothes separately, we provide free laundry service.

reviews.text:
We stayed at this property for 4 days and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience.
The biggest issue was cleanliness. The bed linen was in terrible condition and appeared dirty from the moment we arrived. It was covered with hair and had multiple stains. We contacted the host and asked for the bedding to be replaced. The host confirmed that it would be changed, but after the supposed replacement, nothing had changed. The bedding was still covered in hair and stains and looked exactly the same as before.
When we raised the issue again, the host told us that he could not remove the hair and even claimed that he could not see the hair at all. We have attached photos showing the condition of the bedding and the hair we found throughout our stay.
The property itself was also very dirty and poorly maintained. The bathroom and shower area need repairs, and in general the entire property is in need of renovation and proper maintenance.
We were very disappointed

I’m giving this stay 5 stars mainly because Abdullah is truly an exceptional host. The location of the apartment is perfect, and Abdullah was incredibly understanding—he even allowed us a slightly later check-out. His communication was outstanding: very friendly, quick to respond, and he checked in with us daily to offer tips on where to visit (though unfortunately we couldn’t explore much due to my friend getting injured during our stay).
Now for the downsides of the apartment itself. The photos don’t fully reflect the current condition. On the first floor, the tiles by the room steps are broken, and without shoes it’s easy to get cut. The second bedroom door frame is coming loose, and the sockets by the bed weren’t working. In the top-floor balcony room, the chairs are unstable—one actually broke when my friend sat down to put on her socks, which hurt her back and left her in tears. It was a really upsetting start to her first trip to Istanbul for our 10-year best-friend celebration

“Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev sahibi ilgili, iletişimi güçlü ve her konuda yardımcıydı. Evin konumu gerçekten harika; Pera Palace Hotel ve çevresindeki tarihi atmosferin içinde, Taksim Meydanı’na yürüme mesafesinde. Yakınlarda Mahir Lokantası ve Tekin Kebap gibi güzel yemek alternatifleri bulunuyor. Merkezi konumu sayesinde İstanbul’u gezmek çok kolay oldu. Ev temiz, düzenli ve güvenliydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.”

5 stars purely for host who being very customer service oriented.
Real deal is whole house infested with red ants, our luggage and bags were intruded by them Heavy smoke residue dominating the house, left a second hand smoke with heavy perfume on our clothing after check out. Host initiate for closing the unit for rental after we check out for pest control but didn't, but keep the price lower to rent out fast. Second floor kitchen area is unstable, first and third floor chairs are broken and fell two person, door frame of second floor also flew out when open door, almost hit my child. Almost want to leave the place on the spot but too tired to do so. Trust only the review from Stan, the UK reviewer below who tells the truth. By the way the house is in a deep alley, blocked by residents car, visitor can only drag in luggage from outside to the house. Staircase is steep, pls don't bring heavy luggage

Prefect location, walking distant to Istiklal street. Lots of resturant and shops around.
Accommodation matched the description. Excellent host, very friendly and hospitable. Comfortable place. We enjoyed the balcony. Great value for money.

description: Newly renovated stylish studio apartment in a central location in Beyoğlu Duvarcı Adem Street. Comfortable bed, fast WiFi, air conditioning, fully equipped kitchen and all basic necessities are available. Restaurants, cafes and public transportation are within walking distance. An ideal, clean and comfortable living space for short and long term stays.

reviews.text: It was a very pleasant and comfortable stay. The room was clean, safe, and relaxing. The host was friendly, helpful, and very cooperative. The location was also excellent and close to everything. Overall, it was a great experience and I highly recommend this place.

I had a tough check in, but the actual place is nice. Great accommodation, nice updated appliances. It does look like the pictures provided, very comfortable bed. This place had a microwave as well. I’d say good for young people… the neighborhood had very steep roads so may be hard for older people to navigate and it did get noisy at night with younger crowds of men outside. I did feel safe at all times.

I originally booked this apartment for one week, but because it was absolutely perfect in every way, I ended up extending my stay for three more weeks.
The place is truly wonderful and very close to everything. The cleanliness is excellent, and the apartment smelled fresh and beautiful the moment I walked in. The furniture is so inviting, and the whole space feels incredibly cozy, it genuinely feels like a real home, not just a rental.
The host is an amazing person, extremely kind, very helpful, and always responds incredibly fast.
Honestly, this is the best apartment I have ever rented in Istanbul. I visit Istanbul often, and I have never found anything like this place. I truly cannot find a single negative thing to say about it.
Everything was perfect: the location, the cleanliness, the host, and the overall feeling of the apartment.
Highly, highly recommended.
We had a great time in Beyoğlu, the apartment was clean, spacious and extremely comfortable:) The host was very helpful and responsive!

Bu dairede 3 gün geçirdik. Dairenin içerisi aynı fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Evin içerisinde ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şey bulunuyordu. Banyo tertemizdi ve dizaynı gerçekten çok güzeldi.Mutfak bölümü yeterliydi.Evin tasarımı ve dekorasyonu çok sevimli ve huzurlu bir hava sunuyordu. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. İstanbul'a tekrardan geldiğimiz de kalacağımız ilk yer kesinlikle bu daire olacaktır. Her şeyden çok memnun kaldık. Herkese tavsiye ederiz. Teşekkür ederiz:))))

description:
Our apartment sleeps 6 people and is centrally located. It is within walking distance of historical sites. It is also within walking distance of the Grand Bazaar, tram stops, and the metro.
Our apartment has 3 bedrooms, 1 living room, a kitchen and a bathroom.
There are paid parking lots in the surrounding area.
There are many markets and restaurants in the area where our apartment is located.

reviews.text: The host was accomidating and flexible with their check in/out which we appreciated greatly. The apartment is big and good for 6 people. Very clean and neat. The location is walkable distance from the grand Bazar, blue mosque, Hagia Sophia, and other tourist spots in Fatih. Sometimes the internet will not be strong in the bedrooms because the modem is in the living room. Other than that we enjoyed our stay and would definitely rebook for future visits.

Location was superb with major attractions nearby. Apartment warm & beds comfortable. The single toilet/bathroom was a challenge & the small bedroom was a bit noisy with the hot water control. Ismail was a responsive host & we had a good time in Istanbul.

The place is spacious and the location is great. However the apartment is in a rundown building. There is smell of moisture in the apartment and dust all over the apartment. Underneath the beds, no one cleaned for months or even perhaps years. When you put on the heater, water drops and wets the entire floor of a room. There are ants in the bathroom and kitchen due to molds and moisture. There was also a lot of water damage across all walls of the apartment. Given we were there for only a weekend, I stayed with my family as we were not in the apartment all day. However, if someone wants to stay longer, I would suggest finding something better elsewhere. I should have been more cautious given only a handful of reviews on this apartment.

My family and I had an amazing time staying at Ismail’s apartment ! The apartment is very spacious, quiet, and perfectly located in the city center. Everything is within walking distance and there are plenty of great restaurants nearby. The apartment had everything we needed, nothing was missing. And also the host was very kind to check us in earlier. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!
We had a lovely stay in Istanbul. the flat is great and really well located. The hosts are very helpful and communicative. Thank you!

description:
Stay in a private heritage home just steps from the Bosphorus in Arnavutköy, one of Istanbul’s most exclusive and authentic neighborhoods.
With 7 rooms, high ceilings, and space for up to 12 guests, this standalone house is perfect for large families, reunions, and groups seeking both comfort and character.
Surrounded by iconic fish restaurants, cozy cafés, and within minutes to Bebek & Ortaköy nightlife, it offers the best of local charm and central access.

reviews.text:
Our stay in this apartment was wonderful! The host, Cordo, was very friendly and responsive, and he kindly allowed us an early check-in, which was really helpful.
The apartment was as described and looked like the pictures. The only thing to note is that there are quite a few stairs to access kitchen and bedrooms in upper floors which might be challenging for elderly guests.
The kitchen, dining area, living room, and bedrooms were all clean, spacious, and beautifully maintained. My group of 11 had a joyful and comfortable stay in this lovely neighborhood.
Thank you so much, Cordo! 😊

Look I have had great experience booking Cordo, I was reluctant to go back to Istanbul due to previous bad experience with accommodation but the Cordo was exactly opposite.
It was exactly as described, clean, tidy and amazing people who did really look after us.
The pictures are exactly what you get even better.
Location is fantastic don’t even hesitate being away from central area, it has great bus connection to almost everywhere I.e Beşiktaş, Taksim, Galat, Etiler, Bebek and so on.
Less than 5 minutes walking distance from the sea.
The property has four floors including the ground floor, two bedrooms in each floor, ground floor being the kitchen and dinning room so convenient.
1st floor was the living room/tv room again as you see in the picture extremely comfortable + bedroom and toilet next to it.
Floor 3 had two bedrooms , floor 4 had two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a small Kitchen like area to make yourself tea/breakfast etc.
No lift but this is as best as you get in Istanbul.

We had a wonderful stay! The house was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. It’s located in a beautiful and convenient area, with easy access and plenty of great restaurants nearby. The host was very kind, welcoming, and easy to communicate with, which made our stay even more enjoyable. Everything was exactly as we hoped, and we felt right at home. I would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay here again!

We were overall happy with our stay. The place served the purpose sleeping nearly 10 people with enough privacy and quite place. The team was amazing in communication and when we requested a baby high chair they send us one so quick that i was shocked! Thank you so much for that.
The only disappointing part was kitchen, bathrooms and showers. Overall the renovation is not done well and with little attention to detail. Kitchen and bathrooms were so small that were almost not practical. But they were clean. I expected higher quality considering the price.
The area is super cute with many shops and restaurants in walking distance.

Kaldığımız ev gerçekten çok temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğünden daha güzeldi. Konum olarak oldukça merkeziydi, her yere kolayca ulaşabildik. Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi ve her sorumuza hızlıca geri dönüş yaptı. Konaklamamız boyunca kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. Herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

description: A few steps from Galata Tower. It is very close to Beyoglu, Taksim and other historical places and cultural and art centers of Istanbul. (Galata Tower, Pera Museum, Galataport, Istanbul Modern Art Museum, Galata Mevlevihanesi, Galatasaray Hammam, Cicek Passage, Botter Apartment, Istiklal Street, Akm, etc.) It is an easy access point to the subway, sea and other transportation vehicles. There are also many restaurants, cafes and shopping opportunities right next to and around the house.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great location, easy check-in, and excellent communication throughout. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

I can highly recommend Ekrem's place and hospitality. Everything is just like it shows in the photos (or better) and as described. The apartment in an old building is renovated with all modern amenities and truly superbly located quietly in the midst of it all. The location up on a hill is walkable, even to the old town across the bridge, or upwards to Taksim Square. Generally, like in most places in Istanbul - one needs to be a good walker and ready to climb up hills and stairs. A truly magnificent experience.

This place was absolutely beautiful and clean from top to bottom. It is fully equipped and made our stay feel exactly like home. The apartment is just steps away from the Galata Tower, many local restaurants and near the shops on Istiklal Street.
It is close to Sishane metro and other public transport, which made exploring the city effortless.
The host was also wonderful and responsive.
We highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again if we are back in Istanbul.

Great apartment. Was very clean and had everything you could think of. Was bigger than it looked in the pictures and was really nice decorated. The host was also very friendly and helpful. Location is perfect and very safe, one street away from Galata Tower. Can only recommend this place and would definitely come again !!

Perfect spot in Istanbul near the Galata tower but a few streets away from the touristic chaos. The host was waiting for us to give us the keys and the apartment was even better than the photos.
Would 100% recommend to family and friends.

description:
Stay in the heart of Galata and wake up to the sound of the city’s charm — where history, culture, and comfort meet! Welcome to your authentic Istanbul escape — a beautiful, airy 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home nestled in the historic heart of Galata, just steps away from the iconic Galata Tower.
This lovingly restored home blends rustic charm with modern comfort, offering a cozy, sun-filled atmosphere that captures the soul of old Istanbul.

reviews.text: This property was absolutely amazing. Great views, great location! Located just steps from Galata Tower with limitless restaurants and cafes located directly at the apartment. You can see the tower directly from the living room. The feel and decor of the apartment was very cool and provided an awesome "Istanbul" feel. The apartment has everything you need to stay with a family. The host was incredibly responsive and provided very clear and easy check in/out instructions. My only negative comment would be the WiFi, it was out for our entire stay. It is incredibly inconvenient (or expensive) to not have Wifi on a trip where you are obviously needing to plan each days activities, buy tickets, make reservations etc. I also needed to work while I was on this trip and it was not possible without the WiFi. I notified the host of the issue and they could not provide a fix. If it wasn't for the Wifi issue, this place would easily be 5 stars.

We had a great stay in this lovely apartment. Just as described, check in was very easy, host communicated really well and was very quick to respond to any queries. Location is amazing, literally on one of the main central streets of Istanbul and only 50 metres or so from galata tower. Would definitely recommend!

The apartment is conveniently and centrally located in one of the most popular spot in Istanbul, steps from the Galata Tower. The street downstairs is busy most of the day and night with tourist crowds, which is an entertainment in itself. Across the street is a market, and the rest of the street filled with restaurants available at any time of the day and night. The apartment felt like a home, with historical details and charm, as well as updated appliances. The WiFi is not best, but decent. Our trip felt so good that we gladly extended by one night, which VNG Property made easy.

The flat is real to the pictures, the localisation is really amazing close to the galata tower and many coffee places and restaurants. The only negativity point is the noise outside, as its a very hype corner of Istanbul and the windows aren’t very well isolated. Other than that, the place is great.

Great location with a view on Galata Tower. When you leave the apartment you are close to a little grocery store and many cafes. Nice and spacious appartment feeling like being at home. The property managers were always very responsive (answered within minutes) and everything was very organized. I would go back!

description: Located in the heart of Kadıköy, this modern 1+0 mansion offers a comfortable accommodation experience. Close to downtown, in an advantageous location in terms of transportation. Its stylish interior has a comfortable bed and a clean bathroom. The kitchen is shared with other guests, but it is fully equipped and clean. A pleasant atmosphere is provided with city views and large windows that receive natural light. Restaurants, cafes and shopping spots are within walking distance. Ideal for a comfortable and cozy stay!

reviews.text:
The host is super friendly and helpful, and the check in is very easy.
There is a nice fully equipped common kitchen.
The location is wonderful, in a fairly lively area, and a metro station to Sabiha airport is 5 minutes away.
The room is exactly like the photo, although the furniture is quite flimsy, and the room is right under the staircase, so you hear everyone walking up and down. During the day the heating was off and on the basement floor it was getting quite cold.
There's a fridge inside the room, which is super convenient, though there is no table to eat your food on in the kitchen nor in the room.
The water pressure in the shower is great and the water is always hot enough.
Overall, a fairly nice and reasonably priced place if you stay for one or two nights.

The accommodation is in a very good location and has a private bathroom, good wifi, fridge, towels, hair-dryer, well-pressured hot water, and central heating. It was clean, and the host was responsive. The description doesn’t mention it is a basement room and it doesn’t have large windows as claimed. The windows are small and are at car tyre level. It was loud due to being under a wooden floor in the hallway and due to passing traffic. I wouldn’t call it necessarily cosy either. But the heating worked well and it was comfortable for sleeping for three nights.

yorumları okuduğumda tereddütlü yaklaşmıştım ancak dairenin konumu temizliği ev sahibinin sorulara çok hızlı yanıt verişi ve her konuda yardımcı olmasıyla çok güzel bir konaklama geçirdik daire tam olarak fotoğraflardaki gibi temiz yorumlarda olduğu gibi bir rutubeti ve gürültüsü yok en alt katta olduğu için ister istemez ses geliyor ancak rahatsız edecek seviyede değil bir kez daha istanbula yolumuz düşerse kesinlikle geleceğiz gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz

The location is very convenient and strategic, with easy access to everything. The hosts were very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. I especially appreciated their honesty and cooperation when they found and returned my bag to me. Overall, they were very respectful and trustworthy hosts, and I really appreciate their hospitality.

The place was spotless and put together. Room was equipped so well. It was close to public transportation which is so important in Istanbul. The host always responded immediately to my messages. The only problem was due to wooden ceiling when people used stairs there were some noise. Overall loved the whole space being so wide and it felt like home. I'd stay there again!

description: Experience the vibrant heart of Istanbul from this stylish 1-bedroom apartment located on Balo Street — just 1 minute (80 meters) from the famous Istiklal Avenue. Perfectly positioned among Taksim’s iconic nightlife, Nevizade’s lively taverns, trendy restaurants, and cultural hotspots, this modern 45 m² flat offers the ideal blend of convenience, comfort, and urban energy.

reviews.text:
This apartment was not worth the price, even considering the location. It was described as modern, comfortable, and well presented, but that was not our experience at all. The furniture and fixtures were in very poor condition, the kitchen equipment was minimal, and overall the stay did not match the price level.
It may be barely tolerable for a very short stay, but I would not recommend it for anything longer.
The noise was also seriously understated in the listing. It was very loud every night from about 22:00 to 06:00, not just occasionally on weekends.
The internet was also not reliable enough for a comfortable stay. It appeared to be shared between several apartments, so the speed and stability were poor.
The host eventually moved us to another apartment, but only after several days, and that process was not smooth either.

Turker was a fantastic host, incredibly professional, super quick to respond, and always happy to help! The apartment itself is amazing and looks exactly like the photos. description:
Charming Apartment in the Heart of Galata – Beyoğlu

Elegant furnished apartment in a charming historic building in the heart of Galata, Beyoğlu. Bright and comfortable, it features a living area with open-plan kitchen, two bedrooms, a modern bathroom, and a balcony. Equipped with air conditioning and independent heating. Just steps from the Galata Tower, surrounded by cafés, restaurants, and excellent transport links. Ideal for experiencing Istanbul like a true local.

reviews.text:
The apartment is located directly in front of the Ashkenazi Synagogue in the Galata neighborhood. Very close to all the main sightseeings, with many restaurants, cafés, shops and supermarkets nearby.
The apartment is on the third floor, and there is no elevator, so you will need to climb stairs. There are several ways to reach the apartment from the street; one of them involves using the city stairs from the street next to the synagogue, which may be challenging if you are traveling with heavy luggage.
Clean, quiet, and exactly as shown in the photos. Everything was in good condition, and we had a very pleasant stay.
A small tip: when entering the access code at the building entrance, press the buttons slowly and carefully, as entering them too quickly may not work.
Please note that shower gel and shampoo are not provided, so it is a good idea to bring your own. However, you can easily buy them at nearby shops.
Overall, all was good.

Marco is a great host, we had very easy time finding the place and checking in. Location is very central and right next to touristic center of Istanbul. The apartment is compact but rather light with everything we needed in it. We had some issues with wifi during the first day, but it was soon fixed after communicating with the host.
Couple things I would mention specifically is that the apartment is surprisingly quiet even being in the city center and surrounded by touristic places, but it comes with a price of a bit steep entrance, but it is expected from that area of Istanbul. AC was working well during the August heat and we couldn't be more grateful.

Although we arrived very late due to bad weather, our host Ellada waited for us to help us guide to the appartment and communicated with us in real time, upon arrival to the airport up to the arrival to the appartment at 1.30 am, to make sure everything was OK. The appartment is small but cosy, and equipped with all the necessary comfort. The shower is sheer luxury. The area is touristic offering lots of shops, restaurants and bars, but the street where the appartment is located is quiet. The access with taxi is difficult, although local taxi drivers know the score and do not hesitate in offering drop-offs and pick-ups right in front of the door step. All in all a very pleasant stay.

We had a great stay at this appartment. The location is super perfect, everything is close by; galata tower, tram, supermarkets, shops restaurants everything you could need. The appartment is cozy and equipped with everything you might need and the host was super responsive and kind. very easy communication. Thank you for everything and if you are thinking of booking this place i would definitely recommend it!

It is a very nice place, very close to Galata tower and the Galata Bridge.
The only small thing to note is that the second bedroom doesn’t have a door, so it is open to the main room. It is still quiet and dark, so easy to sleep in. But for people with lighter sleep, might be worth bringing an eye mask.

description: Located in Beyoğlu’s historic district, in the heart of Cihangir, the apartment is within walking distance of Galataport, İstiklal Street, Taksim Square, and many popular venues. Our apartment is situated in a distinctive building that preserves its original character. With high ceilings and architecture reflecting the spirit of old Istanbul, it offers a unique atmosphere. It is an exceptional choice for guests who wish to experience a historic location and stay in a historic building.

reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay in this charming apartment in Beyoğlu. The location was fantastic, in a lively, interesting neighborhood with so much character and atmosphere. The apartment is in an older building and is very cozy decorated, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Communication with the hosts was very friendly, easy, and uncomplicated. Thank you for letting us stay in your lovely apartment — we really enjoyed our time there!

reviews.text:

Communication with Hakan was always fast and helpful, especially regarding taxi to Airport during the holidays. The apartment matched the photos and description, and we particularly liked the layout. Overall, the apartment offers very good value for money and is a great base for exploring Istanbul.

Hakan bey ile iletişim kolay oldu, ev konumu ve dizaynı oldukça hoştu, güvenliydi huzurla konakladık. İlk geldiğimizde bizler için hazırladıkları ufak atıştırmalıklar bizi mutlu etti. Tüm eşyalar çalışır ve kullanıma hazır durumdaydı. Yatak rahat çarşaflar temizdi. Sadece sıcak su arada gidip geliyordu o konu da bir iyileştirme yapılabilir biz iki gün kaldığımız için çok sorun yaratmadı
Hakan beye her şey için teşekkürler 🙏🏻
Thanks Hakan for a lovely stay in Istanbul. The place is exactly as described, surrounded by lots to do. Check in was easy thanks to Hakan’s great instructions and responsiveness.

Hakan bey’e misafirliğinden dolayı öncelikle teşekkürlerimi sunuyorum. Konaklama süresince sorduğum sorulara anında yanıt verdi. Ev mükemmeldi, temizdi, huzurluydu. Hiçbir problem yaşamadık. Lokasyon olarak galata kulesine 1 dakika yürüme mesafesi bile yoktu. Oldukça yakındı. Herkes gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilir, bundan sonraki İstanbul seyahatlerimde sıkça kendisini tercih edeceğim. 🙏🏻❤️

Yine Hakan beyin bir evinde kaldık, bu ev de gayet temiz ve düzenliydi, ihtiyacımızı karşılayacak herşey vardı evde, Merkezi konumu ve otoparka yakınlığı da cabası, başka bir zamana yine Hakan beyin evlerinden tercih edeceğiz

description:
Perfect for mid & short term rentals.

Located at a luxury residence close to the Old Town and Taksim Sq.

10 minutes to Galataport by car
15 minutes to Taksim Sq. and Istiklal by walk.
20 minutes to Galata Tower and Sishane Metro Station by walk
20 minutes to Old Town (Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar) by car
15 minutes to Nisantasi Shopping District by car
25 minutes to Zorlu Shopping Mall.

Guests are required to provide Passport/ID info to the host during check-in bylaw

reviews.text:
Evin konumu gayet iyi. Özellikle İstanbul’a gezi amaçlı gelenler için merkezi bir konum diyebilirim. Tarihi ve kültürel mekanlara ulaşım açısından sorun yaşamazsınız.
Eve giriş gayet rahattı. Lobide görevli personeller her konuda yardımcı oluyorlar. Ayrıca gayet nezih bir apartman, gürültü ya da benzeri herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık.
Ev ilanda göründüğü gibi, temiz ve düzenli. Her türlü ihtiyacınızı karşılayacak alet ve ekipman mevcut. Sadece yemek yapmak için bazı temel malzemeler de olsa daha güzel olabilirdi. Ancak bu haliyle de gayet yeterli olanaklar vardı.
Ev sahibi ile iletişim gayet net ve hızlıydı. Herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık.
Kısa ve uzun süreli konaklamalar için uygun. Ayrıca fiyat/performans anlamında da çok iyi diyebilirim. Yolum düşerse tekrar bu evde kalmayı tercih ederim.

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev çok temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Ev sahibi son derece ilgili ve yardımcıydı. Konumu da oldukça iyiydi. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. Tekrar gelmekten memnuniyet duyarız. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.”

The place is walking distance to touristy areas Taksim and Istiklal, in a secure building complex, and has great high speed internet. Because my travel plans changed, I checked out early. The host was very kind and offered to refund the unused nights without me even asking.
Fiyat performans açısından gayet güzel bir evdi konumu da harika bir konumda herkese tavsiye ederim :)
Very lovely place and very clean

description:
Welcome to our comfortable, modern and completely private 2+1 apartment in Arnavutköy, Istanbul!

• 2 separate bedrooms
• Spacious and large living room
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Fast and free Wi-Fi
• Smart TV
• 24-hour hot water

Location Advantages:

reviews.text: ​Responsive and helpful host, clean space, and matches the listing photos well. However, the AC was out of order for the entire duration of our trip. While the host lent us fans, it was still far too hot. I wouldn't have booked this place had I known the AC wasn't working.
Konaklamam oldukça güzeldi en ufak sorunda bile iletişime geçtiğimizde hemen karışılık verdiler ve sorunlarımızı giderdiler hiç bir sıkıntı yaşamadık evler gayet ferah ve rahattı

Lokman is a gentleman, helpful man and very flexible. İ was little worried before arrival but when İ reached there every thong was great however The property has two helpfuly guards working in shifts . Thanks LOKMAN

Harika bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Konaklama yeri çok güzel, temiz ve bakımlıydı. Ayrıca çok sıcak ve güzel karşılandım. İlginiz, güler yüzünüz ve misafirperverliğiniz için çok teşekkür ederim. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum!

L’appartement est d’un haut standing même s’il restait à la mi-aout 2026 encore quelques petites finitions à parfaire.
Sinon, la Clim fonctionne super bien. L’appart est neuf et de qualité. La literie aussi.
Lokman est très disponible et serviable.
Petit bémol pour le wifi qui ne fonctionne pas ou très mal quand on y a séjourné.

description: Water Garden 30 Seconds away by walking.There is a seating area, a dining area and a kitchen complete with a dishwasher, stovetop and an oven. A flat-screen TV with satellite channels is featured. Fast wifi and smart tv available.

reviews.text:
We were met at the property after getting through security by a friend of the host.
This building has high security but is very modern and clean.
The property was on the third floor with 4 lifts and was very clean.
TV had many channels and some in English which was nice. No guide to using the TV but managed to figure that out after a while.
Large fridge and freezer and hob and oven in the kitchen.
The shower was very good and use of a washing machine too.
All supplies can be purchased (such as washing liquid, milk and bread etc ) at the Mall across the road.
Great shops and restaurants at the Mall too.
All in all we have a very comfortable stay.

Perfect location, nearby foot courts and markets are available. But if you are interested in touristic areas this place is a bit far from there.
Security in the complex. There are some facilities like pool, gym but I didnot try it.
House is clean and cleaning team is available on request.
Good commucation with host.
Recommended.

It was a fantastic experience in a very high level residential compound. The host kept checking in to make sure everything is alright and I feel comfortable during the stay. He was very responsive for my requests too. The nearby mall has a big supermarket and lots of eating options (some of them are famous and upscale places). I'd definitely recommend it!

Konum çok iyi, dairede giysi dolabını kapaksız olması dışında bir eksik yoktu , aracınızı site içine alamıyorlar sadece sürekli kalanlar sitenin otoparkını kullanabiliyor, dışarda park ise riskli ancak hemen yakında watergarden ın kapalı otoparkına belli bir ücret ödeyerek parkedebilirsiniz
Very clean and comfortable flat. Found glasses for drinks which saved the day. Very polite check-in . Highly recommend

description:

reviews.text: Location is great for access to ferry or metro. The place is cheap so don't expect something big or luxury. Make sure you turn on the hot water otherwise the shower is cold. Communication from the host was great.

The apartment's location is quite good. Exactly in the city center. Toilet paper hold was full when we arrived at apartment but bathroom was newly clean. I guess toilet paper holder was forgotten. Towels and hairdryer were missings but after we had asked for them he replies us rapidly and brought the missings. So, he is a good host. Always cares. The photos and house matches, the same. Ty for your hospitality Matenggo.

Matenggo’s place is located right in the action of Kadikoy and still provides a great place to relax after exploring Istanbul.
The apartment was clean and cozy. It is located on a quite side street and less than 5 minute walk can get you to the seafood and produce market. 10-15 minute walk to the ferry and Havabus stop if you are coming and going from SAW.
The heater did wonders during the last week. The wifi is super fast and the TV has plenty of channels. The kitchen has a two burner stove top, large toaster oven, small fridge, pots and pan, and a kettle.
Matenggo is a great host and was very helpful during our stay with recommendations.
Great spot if you want to explore Kadikoy!

Very friendly host, helped us with tips for best way to get to and from airport, when we had a question he answered or was available to help. Apartment location is excellent very close to ferry and buses and kadikoy bars and restaurants but is not too noisy at night. There are quite steep stairs up a few floors to the apartment so careful if you have mobility issues, (but I was ok with this aged 55). The price was good for the central location, easy access to all the sights and a beautiful 15 mins ferry ride to Eminönü for seeing Hagia Sofia and Blue Mosque and other sites. Overall I would recommend and would stay there again.

Very strategic property in Kadikoy. Close to almost everything, metro, ferry, buses, shops, market, and place to eat. Bedroom is a bit small but living room is quite comfortable. Matenggo is a great host. He helped us a lot with useful tips and information. Recommended place for couple with infant like us.

description:
design house with Balcony . Full bosphorus view and green backyard & city valley view ( italian embassy & french palace big garden ).

reviews.text:
This is the experience that has ensured I will never use Airbnb again in my life.
I expect that James will reply to this review in the same way he has to other critical ones below, simply stating that they are not accurate. Any person who wishes to rent this property is free to DM me for the pictures and screenshots of chat as proof.
James was not available to check me in. I arrived to the apartment where the keys were left behind a plant pot outside. The door was rather tricky to open and a passerby saw me struggling and helped me to get in. The apartment was very unclean, a lot of dust , towel on the floor, bed unmade. I reached out to James to express my concern, only for him to tell me that the apartment was clean and that he had made the bed himself. Interestingly, he later said to my boyfriend (in expletive ladened messages) that he was in fact in Amsterdam at the time of my trip. James insisted that I call him via WhatsApp - an interesting trick by him that I now understand was because Airbnb can only moderate host behaviour on the app. Long story short, James spoke to me in a very unkind manner reducing me to tears, after which I decided that I could not stay there and left the apartment. I did not stay at the property, and would not have even wanted to be hosted by someone who treated me in such a way, but because I was unable to follow a fairly complex feedback or complaint process with Airbnb, I am not entitled to any of my money back. The decision was left in the hands of James, who of course thought it was the right thing to keep my money after I did not spend more than 20 minutes in his apartment. Since I didn't get any of my money back, I can only leave a review here and hope that the same thing doesn't happen to anyone else.
Despite all of the above, the apartment is well located and does have a somewhat design aesthetic. If you can get over the lack of cleanliness and abusive nature of the host this could be the right place for you.

First of all, thank you so much for hosting us. The apartment was even more beautiful than it looked in the photos. We absolutely fell in love with the view. 🌅 The location is perfect, right in the heart of Beyoğlu, yet the place itself is peaceful and quiet.
James was very attentive, kind, and helpful throughout our stay, which we truly appreciated. The apartment was spotless, well-maintained, and thoughtfully prepared. You can really feel the care that has gone into it. ✨
If your path ever brings you to Istanbul, we highly recommend this flat — the view is stunning both during the day and at night, and the central location makes everything easily accessible. 📍
We were extremely satisfied with our stay and would gladly come back again. 😊

The first impression after entering the flat was wow. The view is outstanding and the living room is stylish.
After that we started to experience a few issues. First, the flat was not very clean. There was a lot of dust in each corner, and it looked like it wasn’t vacuumed at all under the sofa. There was even some pieces of bags or clothes underneath. The second problem that we experienced was with the bathroom. There’s no door between the bathroom/toilet and the bedroom. Therefore, it’s pretty much impossible to get even a minimal intimacy. We found this really unpleasant. Also, out of 3 lights, only 2 were working, so the mirror there was useless.
The flat has no a/c which makes it really hot and we could hardly get some sleep.
Finally, we stayed with no running water for about 20 hours before we left with almost no assistance from the host, who only intervened too late. We didn’t like his attitude to sell overpriced services (airport transfer, mini bar, etc).

Pros: location, communication, stylish place, amazing view, everything clean except hair dryer
Cons: too hot inside at night, you can hear people from another apartment very good
I booked for two days. It was hard to sleep without AC but very pleasant during the day to be there. View is absolutely stunning!

This apartment is fabulous. It is centrally located near cafes, restaurants, shops, close to the tram, Galata, and Istiklal, but you may find yourself wanting to stay inside or sit on the balcony enjoying the beautiful view of city rooftops, or watch people going and coming from work and school out the kitchen window as you have tea or coffee. The kitchen is beautiful and has plenty of nice dishes. The bedroom is open concept with the bathroom, but you can close off the bedroom doors to the living room for privacy. The bed itself is fabulously comfortable and all the touches in the apartment are stylish, especially the beautiful lighting, and elevate the place. I immediately felt at home in this apartment and did not want to leave. It is a place you could happily stay for a night or two but will wish you were staying for a month.
James was a wonderful host. He was helpful with bags, suggestions on restaurants and what to do, ordering taxis, and anything else you might need. Nothing but the highest recommendation for him and this gorgeous apartment.

description:
It is ideally located for you to explore the Bohemian lifestyle, art and fast paced nightlife of Beyoğlu. Each flat has a special design, they all have marble, natural stone and granite in common. Bathrooms are fitted with special rain showers.
All of our rooms have large flat screen LCD Tv’s, pillows stuffed with geese feather, slippers and quilt covers made especially in the Turkish town of Denizli. A water boiler, several tea bags, coffee and little snacks are also available.

reviews.text:
Overall a stellar experience with this stay :)
The room was very clean and has beautiful architecture and design (an excellent blend of history + modern updates) with a large, comfortable bed, high ceilings, and a large, recently renovated bathroom. The building itself features a lot of original architecture dating back to the turn of the 20th century. Beautiful views of the Bosphorous can be seen from several areas of the building, and there's also an excellent restaurant downstairs that offers live music on weekends.
The location is really close to a wide variety of shops (clothing, book stores, coffee, etc) restaurants, bars, and historical attractions, as well as the Bosphorus itself. Anything of interest can be reached within a 5-20 minute walk, and it's also close to the tram, metro, and a variety of buses, if you want to go further out.
The hosts themselves were friendly and very accommodating. They sent me a message on the date of my arrival to welcome me to the room, and were excellent and fast communicators for anything I needed. I ended up extending my stay because I had such a good experience here and would definitely recommend it for anyone visiting Istanbul!

I had a great stay at Neva's place! The home was exactly as describe clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The check-in process was smooth, Mustafa and Mehmet was super responsive and helpful with local tips. I felt very welcomed and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Booked this place for a night and we didn’t exactly get the room that was on the photos. The shower head at our bathroom was broken and we couldn’t even take a proper shower, which was kinda annoying since we wanted to do that after a long flight. Overall tho the location of the place was great, lots of restaurants and bars around, very lively neighbourhood, walking distance to Taksim as well. Our hosts were very friendly and welcoming. Definitely not a bad place, but some things needed fixing.

We had a fantastic stay at this hotel in Istanbul. The location is great, making it easy to explore the city. The service was exceptional, and the staff were always attentive and helpful. The rooms were clean and spacious, providing a comfortable and relaxing stay. I definitely recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Istanbul.

The hotel is in a really great spot for a foreigner visiting the city: easy to get to metro, very hip and fun area immediately around hotel. Hotel itself is full of charm, room was great, shower+bathroom were great, bed comfortable, simple check in and very kind staff, nice restaurant and bar on first floor.
Would definitely stay again and recommend it wholeheartedly. Thanks so much!

description: so welcome. If you stay at this centrally located place, you will be close to everything you want to visit. In the middle of the city, but a peaceful and quiet street. Spacious as it gets sun on both sides. If you want to feel at home when you come to Istanbul, we are waiting for you.

reviews.text: House is about 15 mins of walking distance away from mecidiyekoy/ sisli subway station. Its located in a friendly neighborhood. We had a cleanliness issue regarding some parts of home but host fixed the issue fast. The bed was comfortable clean as well as the bathroom.

Great apartment with a convenient location. Within walking distance of a shopping center, metro. Nearby there are grocery stores, markets and cafes. The apartment is pretty clean. The temperature can be adjusted. Drinking water is delivered upon request. The owner was very responsive and left a set of basic products and hygiene products, which was very helpful. Internet is good, there is Netflix and a great projector. It was great to watch movies in the evenings. I recommend. Thank you Ufuk.

We’ve been to many airbnbs here and there and communicated with many hosts – but Ufuk definitely deserves the best host ever title! Let me explain why:
– when our flight to Istanbul was delayed and we landed a few hours later than expected, he still managed to organize our check in perfectly and even ordered a bag of groceries for us and snacks for our dog 🙏🏻
– throughout our stay he was always there for us. Order water, fix small issues, answer any question possible – all done as fast as possible. When our dog had an accident he immediately helped us as well
– He doesn’t try to hide something about his apt and was absolutely transparent with us, which is quite rare thing here on airbnb
The apartment itself is located in a very quiet neighborhood – but if you want to have some fun you can reach both Besiktas and Nisantasi in a few minutes.
We stayed here for 2+ months and it felt like home. Thanks Ufuk!
Great place for its value, nice and quiet in good neighborhood, not too far from all the cool attractions. Free wifi was provided but TV and a fan would be nice for the guests.
Evin konumu gayet iyiydi. Ancak ev gerçekten hiç temiz değildi ve ev araç gereçleri eksikti. Ev sahibi eve girişimizde bize yardımcı oldu.

description:
Karakiraz is one of the villages closest to Istanbul. It's a forest village in Şile. Ömerli is between Beykoz and Şile. 4.5 km away from the sea. Our house is in a quiet valley just outside the village. It has 2 acres of land. Two-storey, fruit trees in the garden. There are dogs, cats and chickens in the garden.
An ideal environment for those seeking calm and peace. You wake up to the sound of birds.

reviews.text:
We read many of the other reviews before we came, so we mostly knew want to expect. Seda also wrote us to make sure that we knew about the heating situation. We came in December, but the weather was very mild during our stay (around 16 C during the daytime). The evenings were a little cooler, but we brought plenty of warm clothes and even a few of our own blankets from home. There's was a fireplace space heater in the living room, and there were space heaters in the rooms.
Communication with Seda was very easy. She responded quickly and was very helpful. We mainly took care of things ourself while we were there (tend the fire, etc.). There's a caretaker that checked in on us once in a while to see what he could help with.
The house is older. It could probably use a little more care and a few more lightbulbs, but it is good value for what you are getting. It's very spacious. The upstairs bedroom is lovely with beautiful views. There is lots of space in the main living area. There is internet. It's not amazingly fast, but it was sufficient for our needs. It had the best signal in the living room/dining room/kitchen areas.
Be aware that there are free-range chickens, a cat and dogs. They hang out on the porch and in the yard. We really enjoyed the cat and the dogs though. The dogs we met in the village were gentle.
We bought eggs from one of the women who lived down the road from the AirBnb. There is a small market about a 10 minute walk away, near the mosque. It had things like snacks, fizzy drinks, eggs, milk, cheese, bread, water, and some fruits and veggies. For meat, there was salami and sosis, but not chicken or red meat.
Finally, we had two children with us -- an 18-month-old and a 4-year-old. We brought a portable bed for our 18-month-old. The house has many trinkets and books lying around. When we first arrived, we picked up all the books and trinkets and set them up higher. After that, it was fine for our kids. Our 4-year-old loved the chickens. Our 18-month-old loved being outside in his stroller, going on walks around the village.

Üniversiteden yakın arkadaşlar olarak 7 kız Seda Hanım'ın evinde konakladık. bu yorumu da 7 kız ortak bir şekilde yazmaktayız. Evin konumu, boyutu, dekorasyonu vs. çok güzeldi. İstanbul'un karmaşık yapısından kaçmak isteyip sakinlik arayanlar için hem konum olarak çok yakın hem de çevresi ağaçlarla çevrili doğa içerisinde büyük ve güzel bir ev. Evin civarındaki köpekler, kediler, tavuklar tatilimize neşe kattı. Fakat tatilimiz esnasında ciddi olumsuzlar da yaşadık. Eve gittiğimizde ev gerçek anlamda çok soğuktu. Seda Hanım ise ısrarla evin soğuk olmadığını söylüyordu ki evin içerisindeyken bu bize söylediği esnada kendisinin üzerinde mont ve bere vardı. Olanaklar ve açıklamalar kısmında ısıtma sisteminin sadece şömineden ibaret olduğu yazıyordu fakat 1 sepet odunun dışındaki odunların ücretli olduğu belirtilmemişti. Nitekim 2 gece 3 günlük ev kullanımında 3 sepet oduna ücret ödemiş bulunduk. Odun ücreti fazla değildi, açıkçası ücretin ne kadar olduğunu da sorun etmedik. Sadece bize yanlış gelen nokta; ısıtma sisteminin sadece şömineden ibaret olduğu bu evde, oduna ekstra ücret ödemekti. Şöminenin lüks amaçlı kullanıldığı durumlarda tabii ki de odundan ekstra ücret alınabilir fakat zorunluluk halinde böyle bir ücretin talep edilmesini pek hoş karşılamadık. Bununla birlikte ısınmanın yetersiz olduğu durumlarda elektrikli ısıtıcıların kullanımında, ev sahibinin belirlemiş olduğu belli bir limitin üzerine çıkınca (bu limitin ne olduğu belirtilmedi) elektrik faturasının bir kısmının karşılanması gerektiği kısmı da airbnb ilanının içeriğinde yazmıyordu. Şömineyi yakmaya gelen Bekçi Bey de bizlere üzerine basa basa Seda Hanım'ın elektrik kullanım sayacını ayarladığını ve biz evden çıkmadan bunu kontrol edeceğini aktardı. Fakat bu konu her ne kadar sürekli gündem edilse de tatilimiz bittiğinde bu konuda Seda Hanım'ın bir talebi olmadı. Son olarak ev temiz değildi. Özellikle banyodaki klozet ve mutfak kötü haldeydi. Mutfak lavabosunun içerisinde yemek artıkları vardı. Eve giriş yaptıktan hemen sonra ilk iş olarak mutfağı temizledik. Fakat yatak odalarında herhangi bir problem yoktu. Nevresimler temizdi ve yumuşatıcı kokuyordu. Yatak odalarında temizlik açısından bir problem yaşamadık. Temizlik konusunu bir kenara bıraktığımızda, soğuk olmayan bahar ve yaz aylarında bu evin tercih edilmesi daha mantıklı olacaktır. Kış ayları için ideal bir ev değil. Her şeye rağmen Seda Hanım'a teşekkür ederiz.

- Eve ilk geldiğimizde iç mekanda yerler tozluydu ve silinmemiş izlenimi verdi . Banyolar temizdi.
- Tavanlarda, banyoda kaldığımız süre boyunca sürekli örümcük gördük.
- Üst kat banyodaki klozet kapağı vidası olmadığı için oynuyor. Alt katınki ise kırık.
- Alt kat banyodaki duşkabin su kaçırıyor ve çok sinir bozucu. Uzun saplı çekçek bulunması, bunun zaten biliniyor olduğuna işaret.
- Dış mekanda mangal yapılan bölüm bir önceki kullanımdan sonra olduğu gibi bırakılmış. Kendimiz temizlik yapmak zorunda kaldık.
- Denize yakın mesafede girmek tehlikeli olduğu için mümkün değil. Biz gittiğimizde AFAD boğulma vakasından dolayı arama çalışması yapıyordu. Çoluk çocuk olduğu için biz Şile merkezde gittik.
- TV’de çok sınırlı sayıda açık kanal var. TRT kanalları ve birkaç tane daha.
- Cep telefonu için 4.5G erişim bulunmuyor.
+ Kaldığımız süre boyunca ev sahibinin evde olmaması.
+ Ev geniş, büyük, 7 kişi rahatlıkla kalabildik.
+ Mutfak, buzdolabı, kap-kacak, yatak, çarşaf, yastık, havlu.. vs.temizdi.
+ Ev doğanın tam kalbinde ve izole.
+ Bahçesi çok bakımlı ve mükemmel. Yalın ayak çimlerin üzerinde gezebilirsiniz.
+ Yemeğinizi isterseniz verandada, isterseniz bahçedeki masada yiyebilirsiniz. Hemen yanında hamak da bulunuyor.
+ Mangal imkanı.
+ Kediler, tavuklar, kuşlar,.. Yemek yerken hırsız kedilere dikkat! :)
+ Dış mekan için söylenecek hiçbirşey yok. Herkesin hayalerini süsleyecek kadar güzel.
Öneri : İç mekanda yapılacak birkaç küçük dokunuş ile eksikler giderilerek mükemmel hale getirilebilir.
Teşekkürler.

Seda's house is very beautiful, and located in a very peaceful place and is a fantastic choice for being away from the busy Istanbul. It is however, not too far from Istanbul, and takes about one hr drive to the centre of town.
You must rent a car, or it would be difficult to go around, as it is in rural areas. Local people and the gardener/guard (Abdullah) are very helpful and friendly. It is also located near beautiful scenic beaches of the black see, and some amazing hiking tracks.
The quality of the house would improve hugely with some more lighting (as there is not enough lighting for dark days and nights), some more cleanings, and a Wifi Internet. Some stuff in the bathroom also need fixing. Otherwise, it is a fantastic place.
I would certainly recommend her place, if you are into the nature and enjoy being in secluded area, not too far from the magical city of Istanbul.

Evin bahçesi ve konumu çok güzel (ama gece için ışıklandırma hiç düşünülmemiş.dolayısıyla gece kullanılamıyor). Ayrıca o kadar çok tavuk ve horoz var ki toprak hayvan dışkısı dolu. Bahçedeki salıncak ise kırık sadece göstermelik duruyor.mangal pas içinde çok pis.hamakta kötü durumdaydı.zaten evin içindeki ve dışındaki herşey en az 30 yıllık. Evin içine çok keskin bir rutubet kokusu hakim.özellikle alt kattaki iki oda. Gece öksürük krizi nden uyuyamadım.(ön cephenin dış duvarındanda siyah rutubet çok net gözüküyor zaten). Çarşaflara kadar koku sinmiş,evden çarşaf getirmemize rağmen yatağa sinmiş koku mahvetti bizi.yatağın üzerine serilen örtüde kocaman sarı leke vardı.kesinlikle kirliydi.
Üst kattaki odanın avizesindeki pervanelerin üstü öbek öbek toz belliki uzun zamandır silinmemiş.(oda çalışmıyordu) Evin genelindeki badanada eskimiş. eskitme olan boya bile sararmış yer yer akmış su lekeleri vardı. Mutfak dolapları çok kirli süzgeç ararken açtığımız çekmeceyi pişman olup kapattık koca bir örümcek yuva yapmış. Tencereler çizik içinde. Ev büyük olmasına rağmen ışıklandırma çok zayıf loş bir ortam var yemek yaparken yaptığınızı görmüyorsunuz.
klozetler yere sabitlenmemiş sürekli sallanıyor muslukları da bozuk kısılıyor ayrıca klozet kapağı da kırıktı biz bantlayarak kullandık.. Havlu asmaya bir tane askı yok. duşakabin ve küvet su akıtıyor şampuanlıklar pas içinde.
En önemlisi arkaya bakan dış kapılar kilitlenmiyor.güvenlik açısından bu durum biraz rahatsız edici.
Son olarak görevli sürekli evin bahçesinde ne zaman geldiğini anlayamıyorsunuz bile (gece gündüz )evin mahremiyeti pek yok.

description:
We want to make our guests feel genuinely welcomed in our cozy apartment.
In the region where it’s located, this beautiful building is one of the most unique and attractive example of the Greek Architecture built in 1910. Our building and interior design bring Turkish motifs and modernism together.

Our place is surrounded by cafes, various local shops, restaurants, bakeries and supermarkets.

reviews.text: Mehmet's place was really cozy, we kept saying that we could actually live there long term! The location is perfect if you want to be in historic Balat - so close to all the restaurants and amazing little coffee shops. It is a great area if you are interested in photography. Mehmet met us when we arrived and showed us around the apartment, he was very flexible with check-in/out times and an overall nice person. The kitchen was equipped well enough to prepare meals (although we didn't because of all the great restaurants within walking distance), the bed was comfortable, shower wonderful with plenty of hot water, a small but nice balcony overlooking the lively neighborhood, linens and towels were good quality. The building has a code on the door to get in and it always felt safe. I would definitely stay here again, highly recommend and thanks to Mehmet for the super hospitality!

This place has so much going for it! The apartment itself is modern, immaculately clean, and incredibly comfortable. The neighborhood is so cool, it’s very up and coming so you get a taste of the old and new from the fruit carts coming up and down the street, to the hip new coffee shops on every corner. It would be possible to spend your entire time in Istanbul just discovering this neighborhood. Every turn of a street reveals treasures like photogenic backdrops, antique shops, coffee shops old and new, and great restaurants. Make sure you take time to explore this neighborhood! Bus stop to get to the crazier parts of Istanbul is only a 10 minute walk away. So this location was convenient for our sightseeing but also cozy, for when we wanted to stay in the neighborhood. This apartment’s best feature though is Mehmet. He was so helpful and patient with us, spending time to tell us about the neighborhood, Istanbul, and sharing great stories. He made everything easy, from check in to check out and was a great communicator. We feel we made a friend in him and can’t wait to return to Istanbul. We’d stay here all over again!

My boyfriend and I stayed in Mehmet’s place this past week for our first time in Turkey. It is beautiful, sparkly clean, and exactly as described and shown in the pictures. The building has a very heavy secure door with access control and the apartment does too, making it feel very safe. The neighborhood of Balat is very charming and feels very local with cute bakeries and coffee shops and kebab places all nearby. It’s a quiet area with narrow walkable streets and close to the main tourist sites such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sofya and Bosporous boat rides but not so close that you are in the touristy crowded parts of the city themselves. We enjoyed our daily walk over to those sites.
The apartment was very comfortable. It was great to have a dishwasher, iron and laundry machine in the apartment. We also loved the balcony!
Mehmet is a fantastic host. He replied promptly to coordinate checking in and any questions we had and made recommendations for where to eat in the neighborhood. We highly recommend staying in his place!

Highly recommend! Balat was by far our favorite location in all of Istanbul that we visited. The locals are friendly and kind. There’s a plethora of cafes, kitties, artwork, restaurants and boutiques. Plus, it’s walking distance to the water (Golden Horn?). Try the pide (pizza), mussels, and manti. Beautiful and delicious restaurant called Agora Meyhenesi 1890 just walking distance down the street (down, not up). Plus, the BEST brownie ever is at Cafe Obscura. Mehmet’s place is clean, cute, and perfectly located! Comfy bed and quiet nights. Close to lots of transportation that is easy to use. Mehmet is responsive and kind,

I cannot recommend Mehmet and his apartment enough. He is an effective communicator. He replied to all our questions and messages instantly. We checked into his apartment really late but Mehmet made sure that we had reached his house safely. The apartment was spotless and spacious enough for the two of us. Air conditioning worked really well. The kitchen had equipment needed for cooking even though we didn’t use them. Tea coffee facilities were provided and Mehmet had left a lot of water for us which we really needed after a late night flight. The apartment is in Balat area which is about 15 minuets away from Istanbul if you take a taxi. This is a nice little area with lots of coffee shops and delicious kebabs and other authentic Turkish food. Mehmet should be a super host, if I visit Turkey again I would only stay here. If you want to enjoy your stay in Istanbul peacefully this is the ideal location.
Mehmet took me for tea and we had a nice little chat and got to know a lot of local tips from him.
Thanks Mehmet for hosting us in your clean and comfortable apartment. Thank you very much for your warm hospitality and constant checking on us. Hope to see you again sometime.
Take care
Best wishes
Mino & Kas

description: Designed with country-style decoration

reviews.text: Sevil and her husband were lovely hosts. Their home is gorgeous and very clean, and Ben better than the photos and much larger. We had everything we needed. Only thing I can say is that most beaches are private and the area is very particular to locals, so was not always comfortable as a tourist. We loved the water park that is only 3 min from the home. Thank you again!
Our stay at Küçükev was super nice and comfortable. Great location, spotless clean and tidy. Sevil hanem is very helpful and friendly. We will definitely visit again. 🌻

We throughlyenjoyed our stay at the guesthouse. They location is ideal as it's near the beaches, parks as well as a nice walk to the center of town. The hosts were gracious and the home was extremely cleaned, well-appointed and nicely decorated. The view and sea breeze will always be a wonderful memory of our time spent on the island.
Konumu sahilden 600 metre uzaklıkta, sakin, temiz ve iletişimi iyi bir ev sahibi. Ev oldukça yeni ve kullanışlı. Balkonu ve manzarası keyif için birebir. Sevil Hanım ve eşine teşekkür ederiz.

Everything about the place was amazing, location was near to the woods, the town center and shops, also the place was really clean and had neat details. Although, the price could be less than what it was.
I recommend this place to stay and enjoy the beautiful view from its balcony.

description:
Bosphorus 10 min , taksim 8 min , beşiktaş 9 min , atatürk airport 20 min in the heart of the city .
Enjoy views of the city on the 11 the floor.

reviews.text: host communication and location of the house was very good, also close to terms of transportation facilities. There are all facilities for cooking in the house. The only problem we had was the cleanliness of the house, I regret to say that the house was not clean.

Location was good. but had problems with the stove. Salih would was not willing to understand despite sending videos of the stove issue. Finally he agreed to do something. but still kept promising to fix it but he delayed it and eventually i had to contact Air BnB and had to move out after 5 days.For 5 days we couldnt cook in the apartment. I had advised him that my mother had allergies and we needed the stove to be working. Also the shower was not clean. The water kept clogging up.
tv remote didnt work properly.there was no games console but it was advertised on the listing. the sofa had cigarette burns. Ironing board does not have a cover.
The plates were chipped. Cutlerly was limited. cooking pots were not of a good standard.
Sukru was a great host, he was very helpful and trustworthy, he gave a lot of tips about the city and his house is in a great location. I would definitely stay there again.
Nice and helpful host, good location but the whole place was dirty
Konum itibari ile iyi onu acik olmasi iyi. Giris rahat. Sadece temizlik sıkıntı biraz. Genel olarak uzun olmayan konaklamalarda tercih edilebilir

description:
The transportation points of our apart hotel, which consists of 1+0 concept suite apartments, can vary between 5 and 7 minutes walking distance to Marmaray and metrobus lines. You can easily reach Sabiha Gökçen Airport by metro transfer from Ayrılıkçeşmesi stop using Marmara.

With its central structure, you can quickly access many social and cultural activity areas such as Moda Coast, Kalamış Marina, Fb stadium, Museum Gazhane from our hotel.

reviews.text:
Host was nice and the place was clean, looked like in the photos. However I gotta say since I was coming with the baby, I could hardly find in anyone’s reviews the noise mentioned. It’s very very noisy, especially on the first floor. Noise would subside after 1,2 AM, but generally very noisy location which could be amended with better windows or sound isolation. It has elevator but with even with travel stroller it’s a bit tricky to get in - there are several steps to get to the elevator and entrance door that cannot be held open for a few moments (except with your hand).
I guess for someone without kids and who only comes to stay the night - its perfect price/what you get. Towels, fridge, AC, good location.
Thanks Gencay!

Fiyat performans bir yerde kalmak istiyorduk, beklentimizi karşıladı bu açıdan. Temiz ve basic ihtiyaçları rahatça karşılayabildiğimiz bir daire. Konumu çok iyi, yoğurtçu parkının dibinde, Marmaray ve dolmuşlara yakın. Odalar tamamen fotoğraflardaki gibi. Televizyon hdmi kullanmaya uygun büyük bir ekran. İnternet bağlantısı iyi, sorunsuz film izleyebildik. Mutfakta yemek pişirmek için yeterli ekipman mevcut. Havlu sağlanıyor. Dairenin içi de tuvalet de gayet temizdi. Klima iyi çalışıyor.
4 gece kaldık, son gün sifonda sorun oldu ve klima damlatmaya başladı. Son günümüz olduğu için dışarıdaydık ve sorun etmedik, ama iletişimde olduğumuz beyefendiye haber verdik ve ilgileneceklerini söylediler. Bir de maç olduğu günler stad yakın olduğu için dışarıdan gürültü oluyor, normal ve beklenen bir şey tabii sadece akılda bulundurmak lazım.
Biz genel olarak memnun kaldık, teşekkür ederiz

As with previous guests, I hesitated I hesitated with giving this place a lower review, however because of the quick response and kind communication, excellent location as well as a comfortable bed, I went with a 3. The place is worn down and needs some extra care and little attention to details. While the bathroom had been cleaned, the ceiling was disintegrating due to water damage and there was quite a bit of mold in various areas of this bathroom. There were cigarette burns on counters and furniture and there was only one chair to sit at the table/counter to eat. There lacked a few essentials such as dish soap and cloth (although these were provided upon request) and the kitchen was sparsely equipped. Another downside is that the place is very noisy and bright (no black out shades and many street lights)... street noise, a discothèque right next door and a stadium nearby. water pressure was intermittent and the remotes for AC and TV worked when they felt like it. Cesur was kind and quick in his communication (in Turkish...but translate worked just fine) and despite being a little late, the check-in went smoothly. There was a slight hiccup at checkout as it seems they gave us the only two keys to the apartment (without saying so when we asked for a second key) and as we do at many checkouts, since there was nobody at reception, we left the keys in the room. it seems a locksmith was the required, which Cesur communicated to me later that day. I think this was a case of miscommunication and perhaps a mistake at not having extra keys. If you are not too concerned about noise, so so cleanliness and condition of the place, but want a comfy clean bed in a good location near transport and cafés and restaurants in Moda/Kadikoy, this is the place for you!

The place was very clean, cozy and exactly as described. Great location and super friendly host who made everything easy and even checked in to make sure everything was going well. I’d definitely stay here again—highly recommend!

I enjoyed my stay at this small hotel with excellent service. Centrally located, it was an easy walk downtown, to walking paths by the water, and to the bus/train station. Very convenient. I'm someone who likes to cook and although there is a kitchenette, it wasn't well supplied. For a short stay, it was fine because of all the amazing restaurants in the area, but it's not ideal for a longer stay (if you like to cook). Because it's located on a busy street/intersection, be sure to bring earplugs to sleep at night if you're sensitive and an eye mask, as it is never completely dark in the room. Overall, a good value for a short stay.

description:
We have specially designed this apartment for our guests who prefer a luxurious stay in a very central location. It is just 1 min. to famous Galata Tower and Istiklal Avenue where you can find the best restaurants, bars, night clubs, cinemas, pubs, gift shops, shopping centers of Istanbul.


The apartment could provide accommodation up to 6 guests. The apartment has two double bedrooms with queen size beds, one of the bedrooms overlooking gorgeous view of Galata Tower

reviews.text:
As tourists, we had a long list of items to check off when selecting the apartment for our destination. We could not have chosen a more ideal unit, which soon truly became our home for the week.
Where do I begin? What caught our attention initially were the photos of the Galata Tower. Let me tell you, the photos don’t do it justice. The breathtaking view of the Tower as seen from the bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom were unreal. Not to mention the enchanting nighttime view of the city. The apartment building itself is in the heart of the community surrounding the Tower. Everything and I do mean everything was walking distance. The community is overflowing with restaurants, cafes, coffee shops, banks, hair salons, markets, clothing stores, gift shops... you name it!
Cafe Privato for instance is right next to the apartment building - you have to try their breakfast! A five minute walk down, you’ll find the famous Gunay Restaurant - perfect for day or nighttime, sitting right below the Tower. The list is endless.
There is so much to do, you will not want to leave the parameters of the apartment, but if you decide to, you will find other attractions like the Blue Mosque or Grand Bazar a short cab right away.
The apartment itself is spacious, clean, and comfortable. We were extremely pleased with the layout; tall ceilings and lots of walking room, comfortable beds and sitting areas, great working appliances just to name a few, all added to the comfort of our stay. Totally worth the flight of stairs up to our unit!
My only complaint is not staying longer. Mesut was an amazing host, always available for our every need. He even assisted in carrying out our luggage and calling our cab to the airport. We could not have made a better choice and would definitely book again!

I did weeks of research and compared between dozens of apartments before choosing this stay. We wanted a terrific location with great views and vibes, which is exactly what we got with this stay! Meso's place has THE perfect location near so many great restaurants, cafes, shops, and museums. Batuhan was extremely responsive, friendly, and helpful in both getting us settled in and making sure we were happy with our 14-day stay. The apartment was on the 5th floor with no elevator and the Galata area is very hilly, so be prepared for a great workout every day! The following are the pros and cons (more-so suggestions):
Pros:
- View of Galata Tower and gorgeous Istanbul skyline
- Walking distance to many attractions and historic sights
- Clean and comfortable
- Easy check-in and check-out
- Washer and dryer
Suggestions:
- More storage or hooks to hang clothes on
- Another couch
- Secure windows to prevent rainwater
Overall, highly recommend staying at Meso's place!

The place is clean and in the best location. But there was no lift in building and the flat was on the fifth floor.
Worst of all there was no AC’s in the bedrooms. There was just one split AC in the living room. We booked three nights and the AC in living room broke down after the first night. We informed the landlord and he couldn’t send anyone to fix it till the next day. So we had to move out to a hotel as it was too hot and unbearable. Next day comes and engineer turns up late afternoon rather than morning only to tell us if will not be fixed same day. We moved out and spent the final night at a hotel. So out of three nights paid we only stayed one night. Till now we are chasing landlord for refund without any response. We hope he does the right thing and refunds us the two nights we paid him and never stayed in his place. Never mind the extra cost of hotel booking last minute and the inconvenience going back and forth between hotel and apartment second night and third night.

Would like to take this opportunity to convey my Thank you to You for making me such memorable & Happy memories during my Visit & Stay to Istanbul - Turkey.
Starting from the Help you gave us with directions from the Airport to coming & meeting us & helping us Checkin late at night & making us comfertable after a long flight was commendable.
The references you provided for the night club & various sight seeing attractions turned out to be helpful & enjoyable.
It was really a great experience to live at your place specially the living room area & it was as described on the webpage with spectacular views of Galata Tower from the master bedroom & the Kitchen area. Besides it was so conveniently located near all the hot spot attractions like the Istiklal street, Taksim Square, Sishane Metro Station on one side & the Karakoy tram station to the other.
