The Streets adjacent to the apartment were full of souvenir shops, great restaurants & foreign exchange counters. Not to forget it was vibrant through out the day & late nights with people from all nationality hanging around to see Galata Tower.
To mention Your lovely hospitality made us feel a very warm welcome to the place & also feel like Home.

Location was ideal near the Galata tower and lots of shopping, restaurants and walking distance to main sites. very quiet street in the middle of all the action. Very clean with good laundry and good water pressure in shower.
Place only had 1 A/C unit but in summer it the place cool.
Beds were a little hard and you have 5 flights of stairs to walk up.

description:
Charming apartment in the heart of Istanbul. Just 2 minutes away from amazing restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, and so much more. Unbeatable location with Galata Tower, Istiklal Street and Galataport only minutes away. The Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar are 20 min away.

Perfect for weekend getaway, work-from-home alternative, or cozy home base while exploring everything Istanbul has to offer.

reviews.text: This is a great base whilst in Istanbul, and the hosts were extremely responsive and helpful. The 24 hour check-in was much appreciated too as we got in late. The living areas and mezzanine bedroom are really spacious. The second bedroom and bathroom are smaller but still totally fine. Comfortable beds, modern bathrooms with great showers and strong air con in all the rooms. The balcony is a nice added bonus. If you’re looking for a picturesque, ‘photogenic’ place this probably isn’t it, but if you want a simple base to explore from, it has everything you need! The location is great - walkable to lots of things and near various public transport options. It’s good to be aware that the apartment is on quite a steep street up to İstiklal Caddesi - but that’s just Istanbul! Two nice cafes just over the road for coffee and a great dairy shop with incredible bal caymak just around the corner for breakfast.
Great place, near transportation and many restaurants/shops, very clean, and at a great price. Galateia's team has been very nice and responsive.
Beautiful Appartment! Very very clean with comfortable and stylish furniture. The hosts are very friendly and responsive. Fully recommend

We had a wonderful stay, and could not have asked for a better location. We walked to many restaurants and shops, the Galata Tower, and the tram stop which takes you to old Istanbul. Our hosts were always available to order taxis, answer questions, etc. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay, great location. Everything is just around the corner. Grocery store is right in front of your door. Great staff and everything went very smooth. Very safe area and clean. I would stay there again.

description: super economic studio in balat center. close to cafe shops, restaurants etc

reviews.text: The apartment is really clean and tidy. It has everything you might need. I loved the neighborhood, balat. It’s beautiful and has tons of things worth seeing. Mehmet was accurate and kept and the communication was clear.

This is place is perfectly located in a turistic but quiet area of the city.
You can reach the Galata bridge with a 10 min metro ride. The metro stop is 10 min walking from the place.
Many restaurants, caffee, and place to chill out. The neighborhood is safe.
The apartment is better that the pics. It is located at the first floor, it has a kitchenette, a tiny but complete bathroom (the shower has a good size and the water pressure is great.
The only issues we had is that the AC doens't work that well and during our stay the city experienced very high temperatures (35 C degrees). We asked for an extra fan to Mehmet and he brought it right away. We also asked him to fix the AC. It was somehow fixed, but still not sufficient to cool down properly the room. Anyway at night time we left the windows opened and we could sleep with no problem.
Communication with Mehmet was great and he has been super proactive on each of our request.
Definitely worth the price

Mehmet’s place is small and cozy, it makes you feel at home the moment you walk in. You have everything you need for a short stay, the place is very clean and the bed is very comfy. It’s very easy to find, his instructions are very detailed and it’s close to all the nice spots in Balat and to the bus and tram stations. The street where the place is located is very quiet, far from the crowded areas of the neighborhood. The communication with him was very good, he was very helpful and responsive. Thank you very much for hosting us, we had a great time!

Mehmet is a great host, will go the extra mile to keep guests happy.. did something for is that not any host would do..
Place is in an old Turkish neighborhood giving the true feelings of living in Istanbul
The place is small but did job for us (my wife and I)
The place is right next to the Pictures Balat/Fener and many restaurants and shops. It is also very safe.
Another good thing about the area is the prices.. you get a lot better food for almost 1/3 (sometimes even less) of the price compared to estiqlal etc.
Close to the apartment, a place called “kofteh budur” has the best kofteh and right in front of it in a little street has the best breakfast for fraction of what you get in other areas in Istanbul
Mehmet and Engin speak good English and are very helpful. Highly recommended..

It was just as described, very clean and with all the essentials needed. The neighbourhood is very safe, with loads of good shops and restaurants.
The host was very nice and helpful.
I'd definitely come again

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Everything was great! We loved the location, and overall stay. One thing we will say, is that the shower water didn’t get very hot. We did contact the owners and they did tell us how to get it hot. So they were helpful and it really wasn’t their fault! I think it was just a bit busier in the apartments and we unfortunately ended up with the colder water. Besides that, it was a lovely stay and would highly recommend!

This is a fantastic location near the Galata tower. Lots of cool local bars and restaurants. The apartment is as described. Clean with the most comfortable bed. Lovely cotton sheets. We would say that it’s on a very steep street and unsuitable for anyone with mobility issues. We loved it and would highly recommend it for a short stay.

the location of the apartment was super close to many restaurants and cafes and just a street behind the Galata Tower. upon entry the room smelt of cigarette smoke and i found some hair in the bed sheets. additionally there was no hot water for the shower but the host was great at communicating and came to fix it immediately. overall it was ok, but the water incident needs to be fixed as it doesn’t seem like the first time….

The place was nice and clean. The host - nice and responsive. We had some issues with the hot water, but this might have been just us not understanding how the heater works. The only thing that wasn't as we expected was that there was no wi-fi, which was not quite convenient, but I guess that was just a coincidence - as our host informed us - there were some infrastructure works going on. Over all - we were happy that we chose to stay at this place.

1. The apartment does not fully match the photos on the site.
2. Broken sofa.
3. Dirty linens.
4. Mold everywhere, very damp.
5. Initially, there was no extra bed linen, pillows and duvet cover, although the owner knew that there would be four of us.
6. Unpleasant smell in the apartment: it smelled of dampness and mold.
7. There were no toiletries: shampoo, shower gel.
We warned in advance that we would come with two children. It turned out that it is dangerous for children to be there, because everywhere there is mold and dampness! The sofa was broken, there was nowhere to sleep. It was already night and we had to urgently look for another place to spend the night for the children. This is incompetent landlord behavior.

description:
This apartment is all about location and atmosphere. Step onto the balcony and you’re instantly part of Istanbul’s vibrant street life — cafés, bars, and local energy right below.

This is not a quiet hotel stay. It’s ideal for guests who want to experience the city from the inside.

The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator. A perfect base for exploring the heart of the city on foot.

reviews.text:
We had a good stay at Avirs place.
Unfortunately the area is very noisy , especially on the weekends as there’s a lot happening around and we’re not able to sleep properly.
The AC was not functioning , the fans were placed in the bedroom and living area.
We had couple of issues in the bathroom- as the shower area was leaking, there was no toilet brush, the main area for keeping your cosmetics was dusty and not cleaned properly and there’s some used soaps with the hair in it and loofah that looked like used.
I wasn’t able to use washing machine as I found couple of hairs on the rubber 🫤
The place needs a bit of renovation & new towels and bed sheets.
As described there’s no elevator so don’t pack heavy 🫢
Overall Avir is a great host as he was very responsive and very welcoming.

The flat was as it was pictured in the photos. It was actually very nicely designed. However we did have some issues with several things. Water heater had a failure two days in a row.On our day of check in we fixed it ourselves by looking it up from YouTube but the next morning it was impossible for us to fix and we had to take a shower with ice cold water.Luckily it was June. AC in the bedroom was not working properly, it didn’t cool down the room at all which was a serious problem in the heat. It said there was shampoo, but it was very old, was half filled with water.The towels had stains on them.There was a very bad smell coming from the bathroom, which was directly next to the bed, which was unfortunately very disturbing.T he bed was comfortable and big, however the wood box around it was squeaking with every little movement on the bed.Unfortunately we were only able to stay one night only and had to request for a refund for the rest of our stay. He was very polite and responsive.

The apartment was lovely and conveniently located in a lively central area filled with bars and restaurants. It was clean and well-maintained in the renovated spaces, such as the bathroom and bedroom. However, additional upgrades could further enhance the overall experience—newer balcony furniture, refreshed decorations, some extra kitchen essentials (like a kettle or microwave), and a more comfortable bed. The host was exceptionally kind during check-in and readily available when needed.

The flat is in very good conditions, everything is like it shown at photos.
Clean, with its own style, all good.
Lovely balcony is additional bonus.
Location is very good. Just keep in mind, that that part of the city and the street particularly is full people going out on Friday and Saturday nights, so it might be noisy. Other days are very quiet.
Communication with the host - Avir - is easy and comfortable.
So if you want to feel the city centre vibe, this flat is a very good option.

The host is wonderful. The place is as described. Although, Ac was not working the fans bought by Avir helped a lot. The apartment is located in a vibrant and bustling area. Local to main attractions, and lots to do. I would recommend for 2 people max to stay here as it can easily get crowded. Thank you Avir.

description: You can defentitely be sure that it is the best choıce you can make in Beyoğlu Cıhangır, Istanbul's oldest neıghborhood. Incredıble vıew of the apartment besıdes, Its locatıon is the best locatıon in Cıhangır. It is walkıng distance to all major poınts and transportatıon and is on a flat street wıthout ramp. It is the most elıte and safe street of Cıhangır. You don't need to talk about the sea wiew, you need to lıve and see. Finally, our house ıs on the 4th floor and there ıs no lift.

reviews.text: The view was really, really amazing. You can see a wonderful sunrise. It was great to have a wonderful time in such a wonderful accommodation. The host was very responsive and friendly, so there were no problems with check-in/out. It was also nice that they provided a 5L bottle of water. The air conditioning works well and the bed / sofa bed are comfortable. However, if you have difficulty with your legs it may be better to use another accommodation with an elevator because the stairs are steep. The bathroom, especially the shower booth, is smaller than expected. It wasn't easy to get to the tram station, but the other aspects of the accommodation were so good that I would like to go again next time. Thank you for the happy memories in Istanbul!

A million dollar view ❤️ comfy for 2. 100% as described, amazing bosphorus view. The only thing I regreted was I didn't have binoculars to zoom in the magical bosphorus view.(lets hope Halil soon replace the one taken by the previous customer)
W/ the view & freezing weather during my stay, we just love to have a lazy morning & afternoon watching the changing colour of the sky &whatever happend down there.
Unit is super close to kaktus, one of the hypest cafe in area, mini market, 5 min walk to the busiest street in the area (carrefour, restos, cafes, eczane), tarihi simit withn 6 min walk (super love) and also those high rated kavalti places (van kavalti evi, sa va, etc..) galata port, istiklal cd < 10 min walks. so many things you can enjoy within short walkin distance.
Side note: Unit is on the 4th floor, no lift, halil so helpful bringing our bagage upstairs but still, after last day shopping, much effort needed to bring it down, still, worthed! Higly recommend!

Halil's place is very comfortable, has a fantastic view of the Bosphorus and the Asian side - we had fantastic morning sunrise views!! The apartment is fully equipped, mattress was comfy and Halil had some fabulous infusions and teas in the cosy kitchenette. The bathroom is a little small and shower cubicle is tight, but the water was always hot with good pressure, so it compensated for the lack of spaciousness.
Halil is an amazing host, was there to welcome us at 3am when we checked in and has thought of everything that one might need in a residence in a new city. We stayed for 4 nights in October and he even came in late one night to start the room heaters as it was getting cold. He is a super host, very prompt in his communications and I definitely recommend him and his place!
The apartment is in a very nice neighbourhood, the building is on a slope - although you cannot escape slopes in the Cihangir area (can be an issue with people with mobility issues). Its a short walk from Taksim Square and all bars, cafes and restaurants in the neighbourhood. The apartment is on the 4th floor with no lift or elevator, so again can be an issue for people who do not like climbing steps at the end of a long day. We knew of this before booking so was not an issue for us. Lovely place to stay!
Thank you Halil for a comfy and memorable stay!

If you want to enjoy the unlimited view of Bosporus in Istanbul, this is the place . The view is amazing with bridge, Ortaquay glittering Asian side at night .
Easy to locate , walkable distance to Taksim square , great restaurants in vicinity . Can easily reach to Old city by Tram ( tram station 5 min walk ) .
The apartment is cosy with 1 bedroom
And 1 living area connected by a Kitchenette. The washroom is a bit tight on space .
The only challenge is it’s on 3rd floor with a very narrow staircase , the host is very helpful to get u r luggage up and down .
But ppl with limited movement / difficulty with stairs it’s a challenge .
Also the apartments location is on a hill so every time either u take a Taxi back home, if u take a tram ride , it’s very exhausting to climb the hill / steps to reach street .
Halil host is amazing , very helpful and courteous.

I really enjoyed my stay. It is a cosy 1 bedroom flat with a fantastic view of the Bosphorus from the living room. There are many cafeterias Near the apartment and Taskim square is just 10 min walk. The flat was very clean. Only two minor issues were: no wifi in the bedroom (weak signal) and the shower cabin is small. Otherwise, a fantastic place.
About the host: he is awesome. My flight arrived late and I was able to check in only after 12:00 am. Hall waited for me outside the flat, carried both my bags with him to the fourth floor, and made sure everything is alright. He is also very responsive. He arranged for me to have enough water, tea, and other drinks during my stay.
Overall, 10/10 place. Will definitely stay again. Thank you!

description: A warm welcome from the heart of Beyoğlu! Stay in a stylish, thoughtfully prepared home with a private balcony and 2 bathrooms, known for its cleanliness, comfort and attentive hospitality. Every detail is considered to make your stay easy and welcoming. Ideal for couples, families or friends, with flexible sleeping space. Set on a flat, easily walkable street with taxis at the door, you’re just 200 m from the T1 tram and 500 m from the seaside.

reviews.text: It was the best airbnb experience I've ever had. the house was more tidy and cleaner than my own house :) the furnishings were perfect. Internet speed is very good. The water and the house were very warm. water was flowing profusely. Showering was fun. It was nice to drink coffee on the balcony of the house. The building and the street were quiet. The host, Mr. Can, is very interested and helps you in every way. She left flowers at my door on International Women's Day 🙏 I felt very comfortable and became the owner of the house. The house is close to everywhere. Tram stop and sea 2 minutes walking - metro station, Taksim, Cihangir, Galataport, Karaköy, Galata tower, Galata bridge are within 10 minutes walking distance. There is a market downstairs. The location of the building is on the street. a safe street. Pharmacy, restaurant, cafe, bar, hospital are close to the house. I will definitely come again and recommend to my friends. Take care of yourself. thanks for everything. My rating is 10/10 for you 👍🏾🏠

The apartment is in a great location, well set up and meticulously clean. The photos are an accurate depiction.
Devrim, the host, was very kind and checked in regularly to make sure I had everything I need and was always ready to help.
It is readily accessible on public transport and a short, comfortable walk from Tophane (manageable, with luggage). But it should be noted that there are steep inclines if you are approaching from Taksim and some other directions - but that is typical of the neighbourhood.
The building has a lift and there is one apartment per floor, so there is a lot of privacy.
I already feel that this will be my home away from home whenever in Istanbul. Thank you, Devrim.

I had a great experience staying at Can's place in Istanbul! The apartment was exactly as described—spacious, clean, comfortable, and perfectly located close to Galata tower and major attractions. The amenities were great, and everything was well-maintained.
What really stood out was Can’s exceptional hospitality. He went above and beyond to ensure my stay was comfortable. From the moment I arrived, he was incredibly helpful and even helping me with transportation to Istanbul airport. Whenever I had a question, he responded quickly and made me feel right at home.
I highly recommend staying at Can’s place if you’re visiting Istanbul. It’s the perfect combination of great accommodation and a supportive host who truly cares about your experience.

I stayed at Can’s place for 3 nights with my wife and two kids (09 years & 02 years). I am usually very critic in analysing any place. But truly speaking, staying at this place was an amazing experience, probably the best of stays in Turkey. When u are with family, u usually cater a lot of things to count like accessibility, Security, locality, nearby restaurants/market place. This place matches all expectations. A market downstairs where u can find each & every thing for day to day use/eat. Excelling beds, Clean washrooms, new cutlery, elegant design of apartment & amazing view from main bedroom side window. Here I want to especially mention Owner’s all out efforts when my kid accidentally dropped apartment keys in the side walls of elevator. A guy named ‘Muhammad’ showed up immediately and went all out for funding the keys which were later found in the basement of elevator. Moreover, just a 1 minute walk to nearby tram & bus station for accessibility and 3 minutes walk to some amazing breakfast / coffee places. In short, worth every penny and whether u are with family or couple, I highly recommend staying at this place as I have locked this place for my life that whenever I ll come to Istanbul, I ll stay at this place only.

We enjoyed our saty, everything was accurate as described, the host is superb and always available and responsive, the apartment is very clean and as photos, fully equipped with what you will need.
The location is perfect very close to tophane tram station & Galata port, the way to Istiklal and Taksim is a little bit difficult but you can use tram then metro to be there in less than 10 minutes. The area itself is crowded especially if you prefer to use Taxi, if you like to use the public transportation the location is perfect.

description: "Taksim Square in Istanbul Taksim Square - 6 mins walk Galata Bridge - 14 mins walk Kabatas ferry and tram - 5 mins walk to Spice Bazaar - Grand Bazaar- Dolmabahce Palace - Basilica Cistern - Topkapi Palace - Sultanahmet Square-Aya Sofia - Easy access

reviews.text: Everything was exactly as advertised, excellent! Very clean, spacious with 2 bedrooms and 2 baths, and comfortable. The building was very new and modern with great elevators, air-conditioning, water pressure in showers, wifi, etc. There was even someone at the front desk at all hours. The only thing that may be tricky for people is that it is on a hill with a bit of an uphill walk to get to Taksim. However, the location is excellent and you can walk to Taksim in 10 minutes. Or walk downhill to the Kabataş water front for multiple transportation options.

Pros:
- modern and new house
- close proximity to attractions
- responsive and flexible host
- clean and comfortable beds and furniture
- daily room cleaning
Cons:
- kitchen wasn’t cleaned properly - lots of coffee stein in the kitchen cupboards and old and used up sponge was provided for dishwashing
- location was inconvenient with steep and narrow streets leading to the house. Taxis refused to come to the door and we had to walk up the hill to catch a taxi
- the descriptions listed ironing as one of the amenities. We couldn’t find an iron, and when asked for one, they gave us an old iron with burnt marks underneath and no ironing board

I had a wonderful stay. The place was cozy, clean and exactly as described in the listing. The location is a few minutes away from Taksim square and close to everything I needed, yet quiet enough to relax. The host was extremely responsive, friendly.

For first time I had a bad experience in an AirBnb Stay! There were stains in the apartment, the shower area was really cramped and hot water did not flow in both the bathrooms if it was on at the same time! Also, the location isn’t very good, it’s on a slope, not an ideal location with narrow streets and extreme uphill! The pictures look very different than the actual space! Also they did not clean the apartment and there were hardly any utensils and no washing machine!
The receptionist was a friendly person, who tried to make our stay better!
Overall, avoid this place! You can get better Airbnb at this rate!

I had a great stay. The host was very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout my visit. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in and communication were smooth. I truly appreciate the hospitality and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting.
Thank you!

description:
Enjoy Istanbul at Fully Equipped Flat.Wake up in this bright flat located in the heart of Istanbul.It’s a contemporary designed and well-equipped to meet all of your needs .The flat is just walking distance from public transportation ( bus stops, metrobus and others).You’ll find a great variety of restaurants, cafes, and shops near by your home.

★Central Location + Free Parking + Smart TV + Netflix + Free WIFI + Air Conditions + Fully-Equipped Kitchen and Bathrooms★

More than a home...

reviews.text:
Excellent stay – highly recommended!
We had a wonderful experience staying in this apartment. The conditions were outstanding, with perfect cleanliness throughout. Everything was exactly as shown in the photos—no surprises, just as advertised.
The host, Yıldırım, was extremely friendly, helpful, and responsive. He answered our questions quickly and was always willing to assist, which made our stay even more comfortable.
The location is excellent, especially for anyone visiting a nearby clinic. Another major advantage is that the apartment is situated on a flat street. In Istanbul, many buildings are located on steep hills, which can be challenging, particularly for elderly people or those with mobility issues. This apartment is on level ground, making it much easier and more convenient to get around.
Overall, everything was perfect. We were very satisfied with our stay and would definitely recommend this apartment to others. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The flat was like the photos. Cozy apartment with all the necessary amenities provided. Great convenient shops and supermarkets very close to walking distance. There is also a taxi stand nearby. Concierge downstairs is helpful. Yildirim was always quick and responsive to requests. Enjoyed my stay here as a temporary home.

We are very happy that we found and stayed in this apartment. The place is really great - clean, modern, equipped with everything needed for a convenient stay, good Internet connection. The location is excellent - close to the center, stores and restaurants around. Parking is private and very easy. The host is very kind and helpful, and organized seamless check-in despite the late hour of our arrival. Next time we come to Istanbul we would be willing to stay in the same apartment and we definitely recommend the place.

The apartment consists of a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony. It is located on the 1st floor of a tall, several-storey skyscraper. At the entrance to the building there is a reception with a concierge who is available 24 hours a day. There is air conditioning available, but only in the living room. In general the apartment is clean, well-equipped, and consistent with the description.
The windows of both the living room and the bedroom overlook the "Elm" hotel, and not "Istanbul Cevre Yolu", which is a very busy street. However, I would not consider the apartment quiet, because the noise from "Istanbul Cevre Yolu" could be heard 24 hours a day, including at night. And it was so loud that it disturbed my sleep.

The host is very responsive, check-in is smoothless, there is 24 hour guard and free parking inside the building.
The neighborhood is very cheap and walking distance to Memorial Sisli.

description:
Our flat is pretty quiet and peaceful, although it is in the heart of Taksim. The flat is just a few steps away from Istiklal Street.

The flat designed to provide all your needs. If you want, you can work from home with high-speed internet or cook for dinner or read a book peacefully in silence with high consantration.

Out of the building, there are a lot of boutique cafes to eat something and a lot of local market for shooping. It is also very close the Demiroren Shopping Center.

reviews.text:
PROS
1. Communication with the hosts was smooth and very responsive.
2. The apartment is situated close to Istiklal street and Taksim square, but was still very quiet.
3. The bed is comfortable.
4. The hosts provided a toiletry pack and morning slippers.
CONS
1. The apartment is smaller and darker than in the pictures.
2. The entrance to the building feels rather unsafe.
3. The apartment is very poorly ventilated and humid, with no active exhausts. The towels and bedding started to smell soon due to the humidity. The towels could pretty much never dry without tumbling, and there was no drying rack besides the knobs to hang in the bathroom.
4. Two of the three armchairs in the living room have stiff springs and uncomfortable to sit on.
5. There is a drip coffee maker but no coffee or filters for short stays.
6. The WiFi signal dropped frequently.
7. No AC/ventilator in the bedroom.

My husband, myself and our friends recently had the pleasure of staying at this wonderful Airbnb in Istanbul, and it exceeded all our expectations! From the moment we arrived, our host greeted us via messages with warm hospitality and a genuine desire to make our stay memorable.
The location is unbeatable, situated in the heart of Istanbul with easy access to all the major attractions. Whether it's exploring the historic sites or indulging in the vibrant local culture, everything is just a stone's throw away.
The apartment itself is a gem – beautifully decorated, impeccably clean, and equipped with all the amenities one could need. The attention to detail is evident, from the cozy bedding to the fully stocked kitchen.
What truly sets this Airbnb apart is the host's hospitality. They went above and beyond to ensure we had a comfortable stay, providing valuable tips on places to visit, eat, and experience. It felt like I was staying with a close friend who genuinely care!

We stayed here for 5 nights during our time in Istanbul, which was a good amount of time to explore this beautiful city at a manageable pace.
The location of the apartment is great. It’s in a quiet part of Taksim and only a short walk away from the main square and public transport.
The apartment itself has a lot of charm and is well decorated. There are two double beds, which are comfortable but a tight squeeze for two. The bathroom is good, however there was mould on the ceiling and the ventilation was poor. There is a washer and dryer, but the dryer takes a long time and contributes to the stuffiness of the apartment. The kitchen is well stocked but quite small and the window leads into a smoking area.
Our main issue - the air conditioner was unusable during our entire stay in the 32 degree heat. The batteries in the remote had leaked, and when we asked the hosts for replacements we were left on read. Unfortunately, we found communication overall to be poor and rather unhelpful.

Merve and Ahmet were very friendly. They have arranged for someone to welcome us into the place. Super friendly and welcoming.
The place is cozy and clean, the touches of books and music instruments give a nice vibe and insight of creativity about the hosts.
The location is perfect for us, close to Istiklal, but still not loud or crowded. Once inside, it’s very quiet. Close to Cihangir and a walking distance to many transportation facilities.
We enjoyed having Turkish coffee and tea right downstairs at the cafe next door.
I highly recommend this place. It made our visit to Istanbul unforgettable. Istanbul is a very special city, as well as its people.
Can’t wait to come back again.

We enjoyed our stay at Merve-Ahmet's place, the place is nice, clean and it is really well situated, close to Taksim Square and Istiklal street. The apartment is quiet, there are lots of bars, cafes and restaurants nearby.
However, we had some difficulties for our check in, because the person waiting for us to give us the key didn't speak English, but finally it was okay.
And also, the place is a bit smaller than it looks in the pictures.
Overall, I would stay again at this apartment, we had a nice stay and a good communication with Merve-Ahmet during our stay :)

description:
Welcome to our beautiful home!

It’s a small residential flat in the attic in Kurucesme/Kurucesmeustu neighborhood, with 1 double bedroom and a living room with sofa-bed, and amazing PANORAMIC VIEWS to the Bosphorus FROM EVERY ROOM & WINDOW, very ideal for solo travelers and couples.

Note: Our place is animal-free now.

Note 2: Turkish government now has a rule of 100-nights minimum, you need to select the dates accordingly.

reviews.text:
The unit has nice views of bosphorous. It has big balcony, which is great to enjoy. The unit is made on the roof of the building, so fresh air isn't an issue if you open the windows. The neighborhood is friendly and safe, with a shop nearby. Kitchen has all the utensils, and pots.
The downside of our stay were that, the place wasn't very clean, we found leftover used panties under sofa, and socks and dust under the bed. The host did appologized but it makes you wonder the cleaning protocol. Kitchen was in very bad shape, and we have to clean it ourself. The AC wasn't working during our stay. The TV remote was also out of battery the host asked us to buy it from the shop nearby. There was a smell of a pet in the unit.
I think it could be a good stay if the host focus on providing small ammeneities and keeping the place more clean specially the kitchen.

The house had an amazing Bosphorus view, and the pictures reflect flat's condition. It was clean and well equipped to cook. Also, I worked there, and internet was good enough to maintain a tech job. Owners are responsive, and helpful for the questions.
One thing you should be considered if you don't have a car; there is a very steep slope to reach home that it's not so convenient to walk. Given that finding a taxi is very problematic nowadays in Istanbul, you might have problems to reach the flat. Even some of the taxi drivers rejected to go there as it's too steep.
There is a sweet cat in the flat as mentioned. You should go there if you are okay living with the cat, also while you are sleeping. There are little windows on the doors, that makes the cat enter the room even the door is closed.

Gorgeous little attic apartment with the most stunning views across the Bospherous. The kitchen is old and well used but everything worked and it was well equipped for such a small space! Bathroom too, great shower, just a bit old fashioned which is how we like it! We did a long stay and had no trouble cooking for ourselves and we were very comfy. Felt like a real home, a little scruffy, very comfortable, none of that hotel anonyminity.
The only thing I'd note is that the aircon wall unit pictured doesn't actually work, but there's a modern swamp cooler that's great (you just have to fill it up) and the breeze off the strait is fantastic. With all the windows open it's super comfortable even in mid summer, and we loved eating on the balcony. Would absolutely stay again and recommend it to anyone who just wants a cozy simple base. Even had a washing machine! Thanks Hüma! 😊

We stayed at Huma's friend flat, they are really good hosts. The flat is small and old, but very cozy and comfortable. The views to the Bosphorus were really amazing as stated. It was very romantic especially at night with lights. The neighborhood is very calm and local, you can reach the sea side in 5-10 min by walk and there are many restaurants and bars. The streets can be a little bit steep for some people but it's how you get the scenic views. Overall we felt at home, we would stay again.

Excellent apartment with a magnificent view of the Bosphorus and a balcony you can enjoy while watching the evenings go by. Small, but cozy and comfortable. It’s located on a hill, so you have to walk quite a bit uphill to get there, but the views are worth it

description: We prioritize accuracy for our guests. The listed square meters and layouts are exact, with no surprises. While views and some furniture details may vary, every apartment offers the same high-quality comfort for an equally enjoyable stay.

reviews.text:
After our stay at this place I have dislike the late check in and early check out . We were asked to leave the place at 10:30 am when most places will be an afternoon check out . Considering we checked in late due to flight being delayed there should have been some amendment.
**Location **difficult to walk due to hills but didn’t mind as much.
The Appartment is not too far from
Taksim square.
It was difficult to get a taxi to stop due to the road .
The pool , sauna and gym area was quiet good but closed at 9pm which did not take much advantage of after a long day sightseeing.
We were woken up by a sound ( music ) from the school opposite not great after a short night.
The Cleaning standards were not great, the towels were not changed and the bathroom was dirty and dusty under the sink.
Overall was it okay but quiet pricey this should be revisited .

The location is very near to taksim square 15 minutes walking. Very modern hotel room style, clean and everything you need will be there.
There is also an indoor room with sauna and gym. Reasonable price that I recommend for individuals & couples.
All the best for Mr Tevik

I stayed in two different apartments, both were very well stocked and furnished. Tevfik and Duygu were incredibly responsive whenever I had any problems or questions and made my visit very comfortable, would stay again!

it was a great apartment close to all kind of transportation, very clean and safe building .
Tevfik company is so helpful and great team
highly recommended
herşey mi harika olur, hiç düşünmeden tercih sebebiniz olmalı, süper bir deneyim yaşadık herşey var , temiz, iletişim hızlı tekrar geleceğiz

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Host is great and easy to contact. The place is just as described: clean and centrally located in the Sisli neighborhood. Short walk to restaurants and mall. Would come back and recommend to family and friends.

Thw locations is great, the Appartement was enough for two maximum three people, close to metro and bus stations and in a quite nice safe area , great value of price
The host is helpful and he responded quickly

I’m a remote worker so for me everything was perfect: fast check-in, stable wifi, food delivery knows how to find, good a/c. Rest of things: good location, subway in 10 min walk, mall nearby and a lot of restaurants around but street itself is very quite. Overall great option! 👍
This is a great place in Sisli neighborhood. Close to shopping and restaurants. The host is easy to communicate with. Recommend and would be a place we’d stay at again.

Overall good. Bit difficult with the communication, but Ilyas was very helpful.
The location was good

description: The hotel is a very nice suite room with a private bathroom, terrace and kitchen, where you can live in the comfort of home, in a perfect location in Beşiktaş

reviews.text: Ayşen was a great host. The place was lovely and clean while being in a nice area in for nightlife or taking it easy. It’s on the third floor with a balcony view above the tight streets surrounding the place and with your own kitchen/bathroom. Lots of food options nearby and close to public transit. I ended up forgetting my passport while heading to the airport and she held on it to it until I returned to pick it up. Would recommend the place if staying in Istanbul (Beşiktaş area)

daha önceden de tercih ettiğim bir yerdi konumu temizliği evsahipliği gayet güzeldi. yazılan kötü yorumları anlamlandıramadım beşiktaş merkezde bu fiyata bu temizlik ve rahatlıkta kalmak neredeyse imkansız. herkese tavsiye ederim

Beşiktaş’ta, kartalın hemen bir sokak arkası, çok merkezi konumda olup fiyatları bu lokasyona göre çok uygun, keyifli döşenmiş ,temiz, çalışanlar çok ilgili ve güleyüzlüydü, özellikle ev sahibi Ayşe hanımın her konuda yardıma hazır olması çok güven veriyor. Tekrar konaklamak istediğim bir seçenek olmalarından dolayı teşekkür ederim.

Place was very dirty. Smely trash from previous guests, which I found to late to go down and ask to clean. Dishes was dirty and I barely could clean it because kitchen sponge was so old and dirty. Bed sheets had spots and not fresh smell even though I can understand that it was washed . Kitchen surfaces was simply not even cleaned from breadcrumbs and spots from tea/coffee.
Note that this is Beşiktaş, loud music will be very hearable till 1.30 a.m
Place itself is nice, terrace is big, it’s just needs to be well cleaned.

i stayed in this lovely, cozy room and i was complately at ease. you have your own kitchen and even a terrace. the staff is very kind and helpful and you feel right at home. the neighborhood is ideally located, you can easyly find what you need and its pretty well connected there is the ferry stattion 5 minute walking and plenty of busses as well and the metro station its like 15 minute walking distance. there is a coffee shop on the ground floor and the building is encirlced by a variety of coffee shops,pubs, restaurants and generally any shop that you may need making this lovely cozy place ideal for a perfect visit

description: Hello, the house is a 2+1 close to the airport. The metro will be opened soon. The room in the photo will be the room of the person who will stay. We can remove all the unwanted items from the room. There are 2 cats in the house, both are very calm. I like to keep the house tidy and clean. If there is a roommate who speaks German, we can talk :)

reviews.text: It's a nice cozy flat in a lively Istanbul district. Despite not being the center, the district has a very good connection with the IST airport (only 2 metro stations away, but Uber works well too), also with the downtown. The district is full of shops, restaurants, and services. The hosts are very welcoming, Mehru was online instantly during the day and helped me to find the place quickly. We have a nice talk in the evening with Mehru and Kuzey, I feel like being at home with my friends. Also, they have two cats, who are absolutely amazing. The room provided for me was very clean and comfortable, and my separate thanks for preparing drinking water on the bed table. So, I could recommend this place surely for staying!

Our favorite host in Istanbul! It happened to be my birthday on the only night we stayed at her apartment, and she served us a home-cooked dinner with dessert. It was much nicer than going out to dinner because we enjoyed fun conversations and getting to know her and her roommate. The apartment was clean, a quiet neighborhood, comfortable bed, and they had an air purifier and fan set up in our room. It was a perfect end to our time in Turkey. Highly recommend! Thank you, Mehru and Kuze, so nice to meet you!
Thank you, it's a great comfortable place and there are two huge cats in this apartment, I like it so much)))
Very friendly and helpfull guests. They made me feel very welcome.
Good room to stay for a night on an IST airport layover

description:
In the city, in the comfort of your home!
Homey offers an ideal environment for both vacationers and business travelers.
Homey; It invites you with its modern rooms, and experienced staff.

reviews.text: I had a very pleasant experience at this hotel. The room was clean and comfortable, the staff were friendly and helpful, and the location was perfect for exploring the city.
Had a fantastic stay! The room was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described. The location was perfect—close to everything yet peaceful for a good night’s sleep. Would definitely stay here again!

Everything at the Homey Hotel is the best except noise coming from outside and people living in other rooms could clearly be heard. The insulation work at this place is very bad and is very annoying. Other than that everything else is perfect. Mr. Ismail like everyone else in this hotel is so helpful. Thank you guys!!
Very clean and comfortable room. Many restaurants and fastfood around.
The hotel was spotless and staff was super kind and helpful. Definitely recommend.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. In our carefully decorated apartment, you will have a unique experience within walking distance to anywhere you want to go, in peace and safety.

reviews.text:
The apartment was exactly as described – super clean, well-organized, and with modern, new furniture. The location is perfect, right in the center of Şişli and just a short walk to Osmanbey metro station, which made getting around the city so easy.
What made the experience even better was the amazing host! Incredibly friendly, responsive, and always ready to help with any request. You can really feel that they care about the guests’ comfort and experience.
Highly recommended – I’d definitely stay here again!

We picked this apartment to be near friends while visiting Istanbul. It’s super close to the Osmanbey metro stop making it easy to get to anywhere in the city. It was easy to take the havaist bus to taksim and then direct a taxi to the Osmanbey metro station(or you can take the metro 1 stop).

We were happy with the quick responses, easy check in, markets, malls and restaurants around the area. As well we appreciate the extra towels delivered by the host as well.
The apartment is just as it was listed. There are heated floors for the winter and an ac unit (klima). The couch folds down into an extra bed if you have a child. We would stay here again.

It was great place to stay , clean , comfortable, the air conditioner very good The kitchen has Washer machine and there’s Clothes Washer machine and dryer but the dryer not that good , the street is full of everything you need, restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacy, but if you have a car you’ll struggle to find parking and paid parking in range 350 lira to 500 lira for full day
Otherwise the bed was a little bit small , the walls is not painted 😅 it was strange for me but after a while you get to used to it ,
After all thank you Farid
Lovely place to stay, close to train station and plenty of shops around. The place looked exactly like the photos. Friendly, helpful host

Bu harika yerde ikinci kez konaklama fırsatım oldu ve yine beklentilerimi fazlasıyla karşıladı. Konum mükemmel, ihtiyacım olan her şey çok yakın. Alan çok rahat, iyi donanımlı, güvenli ve her zaman temizdi. Ev sahibinin ilgisi ve hızlı iletişimi için teşekkür ederim. Bu bölgeyi ziyaret eden herkese tavsiye ederim!

description:
Cute and cosy serviced family apartment with views of the Marmara Sea. 1 large master bedroom with an adjoining lounge and dining table that seats 4 comfortably.

Children's bedroom with a bunk bed for 2 kids and plenty of space to play.

Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, freezer, stove, and oven.

Laundry cupboard with washing machine.

Long narrow balcony with views of the Marmara Sea.

Perfect apartment for a young family or a couple.

reviews.text: Excellent location! Less than a 10 minute walk to Ayasofia, Topkapi palace, and the basilica cistern. Plenty of restaurants and bars nearby. The place was spacious and clean. Good wifi. There was a small issue with the hot water, but the co-host John got it all figured out. Would definitely stay again!

We had a great stay at this place, with my mum and my 9months old baby. The kids room has a changing table, and toys. It's great. Kitchen is ok. Living room is also the bedroom. The bathroom is modern and comfortable. Falt is big, balcony is nice. The area is very close to touristic attractions, has many shops and cafes and restaurants. Just be prepared to climb the stairs ;-)

Good location. Two blocks to the tram, 5-10 minutes to attractions. There are many cafes and shops nearby, but the street near the place is quiet. The balcony has a great view and the seagulls always keep you company.
The apartment is on the third floor, and there are very steep streets with paving stones nearby. It was a little difficult for us with a baby and a stroller.
There is a big bottle with a pump with clean water for drinking — it's great and rare for Airbnb. There is gas heating and plenty of blankets.

Overall a good experience. Host was there when I arrived, and even was good enough to haggle with the taxi driver trying to triple the price of the ride. It was a bit strange though to be asked for an additional $25/ day for having a guest in an apartment that was listed as sleeping 5 with no mention of extra cost per person in the description. I said no, and they accepted it but it was awkward. Also, while it was lovely to have such conveniences as a dishwasher and washing machine, no soap was provided nor even hand washing soap for dishes. There was a third of a roll of toilet paper which we used in a couple days and then it took another 24 hours to hear back from the owners. At that point we had already bought all of these things, not a big deal but one does expect such basics to be provided in an Airbnb. Not even so much as salt and pepper, so expect to go the market. The other oddity was one of the “bedrooms “ is just a bed in the living room. It worked out but again, unexpected.
Great location. Highly responsive hosts. Comfortable bed. Great local eats!

description: The flat is just next to Galata Tower which is one of the most famous historical landmarks of Istanbul. It is in the intersection of local and other touristical areas also 3 minutes away from metro and bus stations where you can also hail a cap. There are many boutique cafes around where you can have coffee - breakfast ( One is under the building opposite the supermarket) The rooftop with breathtaking view is accessible for you to take your breakfast or a grab a drink at nights.

reviews.text: Terrific location! Cemil was very helpful with instructions for self checkin. The studio is much smaller than the wide angle photos make it appear. A few amenities listed that were not present (oven, first aid, smoke alarm, fire extinguisher). We also were unable to get the hairdryer to work and was quite full of dust. If looking for a decent price in a central location, it works.

This was a great studio apartment right next to Galata tower. There was very little noise from the street as it was down a quieter side street with a small cafe and mini mart which were handy.
The flat was comfortable and a nice size with clean linen and surfaces throughout. The bed was comfortable if on the slightly smaller size but I am 197cm. It had a good A/C and a simple kitchenette which we only used the fridge and kettle.
The host was really helpful and flexible with the check in time. He was kind enough to message us when there was a power outage to the whole area (was a rare occurrence and affected the Taksim to Galata) to let us know what was going on.
Overall great stay and would recommend this place to friends!

The location of the apartment is really great and it looked exactly like in the pictures. Cemoli was very friendly and answered quickly. The bed was really comfortable. Only thing that was a real problem for us was the bathroom, as it had a lot of mold on the ceiling and the shower and the whole bathroom really smelled strong like it. We always had to air it like 30 minutes before we could use it (the bathroom itself has no window so we had to air it threw the room we lived in, which was kind of smelly as well afterwards). Would recommend if the mold wasn’t there.

Ideal location! The room is beautifully located, close to all the sights, and the view from the shared terrace is simply breathtaking!
The place is relatively quiet, compared to the noise a few meters above, at Galata tower. (without mentioning the air conditioning noises, however) Only downsides: the smells that sometimes rise from the bathroom, and the smallness of the room compared to the pictures. The kitchen is in a corner of the room, and can be used only for breakfast... There is not even a pan to cook anything.

A studio apartment in a great and happening neighborhood, just a few meters away from the Galata Tower. The apartment is clean and confortable, sits on a quiet homey alley, and has a communal rooftop terrace with nice views of the city. Cemil is a great host who can give you directions when needed. The kitchen could be a bit bigger but there’re plenty of good and reasonably priced restaurants in the vicinity. Don’t leave without trying the dirt-cheap breakfast sandwiches on the deli that’s in the building, and without unwinding after a long day of walking at the Adda Galata cafe that’s on the street corner.

description: I had a lot of fun preparing this house with a small apartment full of stylish details. It has simple, functional and beautiful pieces that I think will make you feel good the moment you step inside. The location is very central and comfortable.

reviews.text:
Was a very nice stay in Tugbas Apartment. It was small but tidy and comfy. It got a little cold at night and the shower had some issues, eg it was either only cold water or boiling hot. We struggled to take a shower. However, the apartment was still nice and it was worth its money. It’s in the 4th floor tho without a lift, so keep this in mind!
The location was amazing and everything was nearby, reachable by foot.

Türkiye’de 1 hafta kalacaktık. Bizim için en önemli nokta konakladığımız evin lokasyonuydu. Tuğba’nın evi mükemmel bir konumda. Gideceğimiz her yere çok rahat ulaştık. 10 dakikalık bir yürüme ile metro ve vapur iskelesine varıyorsunuz. Akşamları ise genellikle kadıköyde geçirdik. Yürüme mesafesinde birçok güzel mekan var. Çok canlı ve güvenli bir semt, biz çok keyif aldık. Ev tamamen görsellerdeki gibi. Küçük, şirin bir dizaynı var. Çok da temiz bir evdi. Tekrar gelirsek yine Tuğba’yı tercih ederdik diyerek ayrıldık evden. Bir tek banyoda sıkıntı çektik. Duş başlığından su neredeyse hiç akmıyor denecek kadar az akıyor ve kabininin kapısı bozuktu. Dolayısıyla zaten çok küçük bir alanda çok zorlanarak duş aldık. Bir de evde zaten varmış diye kendi ütümüzü getirmemiştik fakat ütünün kendisi değil sadece kutusu vardı. Banyo sorunu çözülürse evin başka hiçbir sıkıntısı yok. Biz gezimizden çok memnun kalarak İskoçya’ya döndük. Aradığımız güvenli ve temiz bir evdi, Tuğba’ya teşekkür ederiz.

It was a great stay in Istanbul. Great location in Kadiköy where you can find many bars and go quickly by ferry to other parts of the city. The place was clean and everything works as described. Only the shower was not working properly but this can be fixed in the future.

place is like in the pictures. clean, cosy and very city-centric. 4 floor without elevator can be pain during summer with luggages. hosts were very friendly and helpful, they have always replied quickly. this cosy place has kitchen staff, washing machine, kettle etc. very convenient actually. i only experience lack of tv, but net speed was good and we handled that need via computer. thanks for all their help and clear instructions again. gonna visit again.

konum olarak basit ve iyi bir yerde girişi basitti yatakta saç,kıl vb. şeyler vardı. yerler tozdu temiz değildi.çamaşır koyulabilicek bir dolap askılık daha da iyi olurdu ev sahibi ve çalışan kişiler gayet iyiydi fiyat performans açısından gayet yeterli ulaşım çok basit

description: Welcome to our brand newly designed modern 2bed/1bath home in the heart of Bebek! Tucked away on a quiet residential street with a private entrance. Moments away from the Bosphorus, Bebek park, shops, restaurants, cafes and transportation links.This home is a great home away from home! Situated on the 1st floor, comes with high speed internet, smart tv(netflix), an open fully equipped kitchen and a cozy bedroom!

reviews.text: Book this for the location. You are tucked into a quiet street in a great neighborhood. There is only one AC unit and it is in the living room - if you keep the bedroom doors open at night it is good enough. The host was gracious and let us check in early because the cleaning was completed which was kind. The bathroom needs a deep clean and the bedrooms could use mirrors but overall it is a good value.

Location is great, home is cozy and super clean, comfortable mattresses , good quality linens and towels. Super Clean kitchen. Responsible host. In general, this unit was not comparable to other houses in terms of cleanliness and comfort. This home was really clean

Great find. I'm glad the days I need it worked out at this property. Very clean, nice beds and linen, we'll equipped kitchen.
The host was very helpful by letting us leave our bags in the unit while they were cleaning it, because we had to return the rental car.
Good location. Definitely recommended it.
Thank you.

We loved our stay in Bebek with my 2 kids. We were 3 adults, 1 baby and 1 child.
Apartment was as described and great to get starter kits from the host on cleaning materials.
We have been provided baby cot and high chair.
Host was proactive and easy to reach out, our check-in was smooth and location is great. Very close to Bebek Park and in a nice and quiet cul-de-sac.
We will definetely return.

Overall good location in bebek and clean house with good natural lighting but a couple of points for other guests to pay attention to:
House front door might be different and might not be clearly marked on the pictures attached. The staircase of one of the front doors is very dangerous and please pay attention when entering as it is unsafe especially at darker time.
There’s practically no safe sidewalks when walking to/from Bebek water front. Be extra careful especially since cars drive very fast there.
Bring your own toothpaste and also your own slippers in your house.

description: Villa Galley is an 10 room facility. This room is for 2 people and is the smallest room of our facility. Our room sizes vary and we can accomodate up to 4 persons in a room. Please check availability of the other rooms if the one you are looking for is unavailable/booked. The rooms are identical in terms of equipment.

reviews.text:
This accommodation felt like staying in a hotel with it's extra comforts and service but still with the privacy that you get from an airbnb. In your room you have your own bathroom (very small shower) a comfortable bed, tv, mini fridge (stocked with water) and plenty of space for your luggage. The shared kitchen has all the cooking cooking utensils needed and plenty of seating to even just hang out with other guests. The fridge in the kitchen is also stocked with water and juice for guests to help themselves to.
The host is always there to help and goes above and beyond to do so. We were given advice on where to eat cheap (away from the tourist area) and he even walked us to the restaurant and stayed to show us how to eat one of their typical dishes. Our flight was changed last minute to late afternoon and we were given the room until we had to leave to the airport at no additional charge
The location is perfect. Walking distance to all the major attractions of the old city yet far enough out to come home to a quiet nights sleep. The walk to the start of the sights took us about 15-20mins and we walked our way all over the city.
We highly recommended.

I stayed in Villa Galley with my friend. Here is my review, and below you will find hers.

The listing was accurate. It is a small boutique hotel - I believe they have 9 rooms in total.
Location: In my humble opinion, cannot be better. You are close to Bosporus, Little Aya Sofia is just around the corner, and it would normally take me about 5 minutes to walk to the Sultanahment Square. On the other hand, the neighbourhood is quiet, and serene. It is a beautiful area to come home to after a long day of exploring.
Hospitality: Superb! Can and Mert, the owners, are truly wonderful. They are supportive, sweet, caring, modern and cheerful. They will make you feel completely safe.
The room: Very clean and cared for! Powerful aircon, a comfortable bed, and nice modern shower (with proper water pressure!).
The kitchen: Small and neat. I spent many an hour reading there in the evenings. You can make tea, cook, and use the refrigerator.
-Dara

"Galley" is an awesome place to stay in Istanbul if you are looking for a quiet and comfortable one. I felt like at home and every evening after full of impressions day my friend Dara and I with pleasure were spending time at cup of Turkish tea with our new friends at kitchen. That place seems for me a real home far away from home.
-Kate

pour le airbnb :
We stayed for 10 days, which for most of these, one of us was recovering from a surgery. During our whole stay, the staff has been amazingly accommodating, they made sure we had everything we needed and accommodated us with our irregular demands. They have been incredibly understanding and made us feel welcome and cared for. We stayed in at the hotel most of the time for recovery, and the little common areas (kitchen, terrace), made a big difference in our well being.
Everything was clean, cleaning staff was helpful and efficient. Changing all towels and mats every time.
The room’s facilities were all functional and clean.
The location is great, has quick eats and restaurants nearby, pharmacies, groceries, shops etc. It is easy to walk out and go for sightseeing the old town.
I fully reccommend Galley Hotel for a pleasant stay in Istanbul and would visit again anytime.

Can Serbay was very welcoming and helpful. His place was easily found by the taxi driver using GPS from Attuturk Airport. The building / room is modern, clean and attractive. It is about two blocks walk from a nice park with a playground for neighborhood children. It was about 10 minutes walk to the major sites we hoped to see on our short trip (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern). The walk to the Grand Bazaar was about a 10 minute walk (up a steep hill!), but next time I'd go by the major sites and then walk up the less steep hill from there. Every meal we had in a restaurant in the general area was superb. We had a fabulous time and we able to stay longer due to the low price of our accommodations, which were is excellent condition and very comfortable. Thank you Can Serbay!

Thank you Can for being such a great host! We loved it! Everything was perfect. It was really clean and comfortable. Although weather in Istanbul was really cold, the apartment was really warm! Thanks for the water, tea and coffee as a welcoming gesture, as well as candy! The location is great, the villa Galley is really near Sultan Ahmet Mosque, and public transport. 10/10 and hope to see you again!

description:
A romantic design apartment in the heart of Cihangir, created especially for couples and design lovers. The bedroom features a freestanding vintage bathtub, while the living room turns into your private cinema with a projector. Cafés, restaurants, galleries and Istanbul nightlife are just outside your door.

Every piece was curated to create a warm, character-filled stay with a true retro spirit—blending 1960s design with modern comfort.


The Retro is in 3rd floor, no elevator.

reviews.text:
Let’s start with the Pros:
- Looks just like the pictures
- Great location to walk to taxis, metro, tram, shopping/club area and cute restaurants
- Very private and felt very safe
- Well furnished
- Responsive host
- Laundry within unit
- Fast Wi-Fi
Cons :
- Weird Smell like sewage throughout unit. (I suspect coming from the bathtub which did not have a drain cover)
- No Microwave
- No TV. Only Projector which only works after sundown (8:30pm) and when all lights off.
- Shower drainage was slow
- No AC in bedroom which made it quite hot. I eventually got a fan from the host.
- Paper Thin walls and you can hear people coming in and out of building, people talking outside, etc
Also note that the 5am sunrise means the house gets very bright very early and the shades don’t do much to help. So bring a sleeping mask.
The host was nice and helped coordinate with luggage delivery when my luggage was delayed.

We had a great stay at Tao’s apartment in Istanbul. The location is ideal; right in the heart of the city and within walking distance of many excellent restaurants, cafés, and attractions. The apartment itself is very well decorated, with a stylish and comfortable atmosphere that made it easy to feel at home.
One thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is not suitable for guests with limited mobility, as it requires climbing quite a few stairs to access.
Overall, a wonderful place to stay if you’re looking for charm, convenience, and a lively neighborhood.

It felt like home. The house is really cozy and the interior is beautiful. The location was hard to get to and take into consideration there is not elevator so if you have bags you will have to carry them on the stairs. Walking distance to Taksim. Tao sent us a list of recommendations for restaurants near by which was really helpful. It was a great stay☺️

The place was beautiful. We loved everything in this place! it made us feel like locals living our day-to-day life there
we especially loved the bathtub in the bedroom, the arch in the kitchen, and the overall retro theme of the apartment! super cozy and aesthetic. Everything we ever needed was available for us right there. The host was super helpful and suggested some great local restaurants and attractions around the area that we loved so much.
Will definitely book the place again on our next trip to Istabul.

Tao’s apartment is stylish and homey, and had everything we needed. It’s location in Cihangir is excellent: close to tons of cool restaurants and cafes, not far from the Findliki tram stop that takes you across the Golden Horn or bus stop that takes you north up the European side of the Bosphorus, both of which we took advantage of. The tram stop is down a ton of stairs - be ready for stairs! We were so relieved that the apartment had a washer/dryer. Tao gave us restaurant recommendations and even offered to help us get a taxi to the airport. Overall, a generous host and a fun, comfy, well-located apartment. I’d stay there again!

description:
Residence has one bedroom and a living room
Residence cleaning service
The residence is located in a quiet neighborhood in Bimonti, close to Cevahir Shopping Mall, Harbiye and Nişantaşı
There are two air conditioning units (living room + bedroom) in the residence.
All electronic devices (washing machine + dishwasher + oven + gas stove) are available in the residence
The residence is close to commercial areas and can be easily reached by metro or bus.
The residence is close to the metrobus stop in Mecidiyöy.

reviews.text: Great place, as advertised, price was right, quiet neighborhood, great communication, easy to get around . Everything you need is within a few blocks. I would definitely stay there again, and Feras was in touch when needed, and very helpful.

1. The most important thing for me is cleanliness. the apartment is well cleaned and it is clean. The cleaner cleans very well, which is usually a rarity in Turkey. 2. quiet area, even on holidays it is quiet, despite the poorly closed balcony and poor sound insulation. 3. there is enough space for two people, the kitchen and living room are large for such an apartment. 4. The owner speaks English, all the instructions for the swing were clear. (My EN is bad, sorry)

Labai jaukus ir šiltas butas, patogioje vietoje. Patogu ir paprasta atvykti iš oro uosto metro. Mielai apsistočiau ir vėl, ir rekomenduoju draugams, ieškantiems būsto toje vietovėje.
Kruopščiau išvalius ir šiek tiek atnaujinus būtų tobulas, visai kaip nuotraukose.
Gittiğimde evin kombisi bozuk olduğunu söyledi son dkda mağdur olmamak için başka evde konakladık o açıdan mağdur olduk biraz onun dışında iletişimi iyiydi bir sıkıntı olduğunda iletişime geçebildik
Her şey güzeldi. Ev son derece temiz ve gerekli hemen her şey mevcuttu. Sadece giriş ve çıkış talimatlarıyla ilgili net bilgiler verilmedi ve Feras beye ulaşmakta biraz zorlandık.

description: From this central location, you can easily access everything as a group. It is on Balo Street, a 3-step walk to Istiklal Avenue.

reviews.text:
The apartment was Great, location was amazing. Everything was clean and tidy. Check-in and Check-out was uncomplicated. Good bed, comfortable pillows. Silent and Perfectly working air conditioning. Enough Space for two persons. Communication was easy, Fast and good. Because of the down Town Location and many Bars and Clubs in the nearby area it can get a Little Bit louder at Night. Luckily there were „Oropax“ available. There could have been more towels.
All in all we were very satisfied with Mehmets apartment :)

I had a great stay here! The neighborhood is fantastic, with everything you need close by—shops, restaurants, and more. Having an elevator was a big plus, especially for convenience. The AC and heating worked perfectly, making the stay very comfortable. While there are some nightclubs in the area that stay open late, we barely heard any noise, so it wasn’t an issue at all. Mehmet was very kind and helpful throughout our stay, making sure everything was perfect. Highly recommend this place!

We had a wonderful stay at Mehmet Ali’s listing. The house was exceptionally clean, and the bed was comfortable. The washing machine and dryer were great conveniences, though you'll need to bring your own detergent, as there is no ironing board.
Mehmet provided excellent food recommendations and suggested various tourist attractions, enhancing our experience. He also gave clear instructions on how to find his apartment, making our arrival smooth.
One downside was the check-in process; it would have been easier if automated, especially since Mehmet was waiting for us when we were delayed in the airport. There was a bit of a drainage smell in the toilet, but I believe Mehmet will fix this. It can get noisy at night, but ear buds are provided, and it didn’t bother me much.
Overall, it’s a fantastic stay with great value, and there are plenty of restaurants nearby.
Tip for Tourists:
For airport transport, arrange third-party services. Avoid the yellow cab at all cost!

The apartment is well furnished, clean, and in a very central location, just as described.
The host is very friendly and responsive and made our stay in his place very convenient and easy.
Highly recommend if you want to stay close to Taksim Square in a very central area of Istanbul. we walked everywhere.

First of all, we'd like to thank Mehmet for our comfortable stay for 7nights. He was very friendly and responsive host. Communication with him was excellent. Location was the best advantage to stay here. With less than 1 min walk, we could reach istiklal ave which has a lot of restaurants, cafes and also places for shopping. His place was very clean and also comfortable. If I visit Istanbul next time, I will definitely stay in Mehmet's place again. Highly recommend to everyone.

description: This Skymoon Hotel room, which is 10 minutes' drive from Istanbul Airport, 7/24 reception and room service. This room is 20 m2 in size and includes; Air conditioning, electric kettle, minibar, safe box, welcome drink, free water, free tea and coffee pocket, hot water are available.

reviews.text:
Stayed here overnight to save money on flights. There's a bus stop to/from the airport right next to it. I highly recommend this if you don't want to get scammed by the taxis. You can pay for the bus with a credit card or with a pre-loaded istanbulkart (bus/metro pass)
It's a nice place to sleep for sure and there's food service in the hotel. It's pricey for Turkish standards, but not by U.S. standards. There are some other restaurants and small markets within walking distance.
The bed and room was really clean and comfortable. Has a TV and air conditioning as well as a kettle and some coffee provided. The only negatives were the fact that the shower didn't get hot, and the keys are an older style key that is not very secure. I didn't feel unsafe at any time though as it's a pretty peaceful part of town and turkey is pretty safe in general.
Overall a great experience.

Good value option for a short layover at Istanbul Havalimani. The flexible check in was very helpful as our flight was delayed and we arrived at 3am, a time many other hotels did not allow check in. We were grateful for this. The hotel itself is very basic but does the job, rooms are reasonably clean and comfortable. However, the walls are indeed very thin and it sounded like the people on our floor were in the room! I did not mind the sound of flights passing over so much, but perhaps not ideal for light sleepers. We also had problems with the hot water but since we only stayed a night did not try to resolve it. Overall did the job for one night and we were grateful to rest there.

I had a wonderful stay! The host was kind, responsive, and made sure everything was perfect during my visit. The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. I really appreciated the little touches and the warm welcome. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this host to anyone looking for a great Airbnb experience!

The location is in a town that's close to the airport. It should it take no more than 10-15 minutes to get there. Good for an overnight layover.
The cab ride costs between 350-450 tl
You generally should not be paying over 400.
This is a hotel, so checking in is very flexible as there is always someone at the counter. They can also call the taxi for you.
Each room is clean, air conditioned, the beds are made. Amenities like bathroom soaps and bottles of water are included. Blackout curtains as well. The hotel runs very well and has met all expectations.
The street it's on has a variety of small places to eat along it, and a convenience store.
I needed a place to sleep before my flight the next day. This hotel was perfect

The host was very kind and helpful after I had a horrible ordeal with another hotel that had scammed me when I had gotten lost. The host was really reassuring and apologised for what the other hotel had done. The room was warm, clean and looked like the pictures. It was very good value for money. And felt safe and secure. The only minor complaint is that the street noise was a little loud outside.

description:
A central apartment very close to shopping areas in Merter, suitable for family and business stays. Fast internet and air conditioning in the living room are always available.
The tram station is 100 meters from the house. This nostalgic tram arrives at tourist attractions in 30 minutes.

reviews.text: The host was excellent and very welcoming. Communication was quick and easy, and everything was exactly as described. The place was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and we had a great stay. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb and would be happy to stay here again!

It was a very good clean place and all close to you don’t have to go far to buy anything. Everything is downstairs.
And the train station five minute far to take you all the tourist places like Fatih big bazaar, Sultan Ahmed and the host are just gentleman he will help with everything I really enjoy my stay there just perfect. I will definitely come back to this house in my next visit to İstanbul.

It’s exactly same as photos , so clean and good . Oguz is a so kind host and always he and his son are prepare to help . I liked it . The only problem is five time Azan noise . Actually The mosque loudspeakers faced directly toward the building. The call to prayer was broadcast five times a day, starting around 5 a.m., at a very high volume. It often woke me up suddenly and was the most disturbing part of my stay.

Selamlar bu evde kendi evinizde gibi hissedeceksiniz. Girişte dolap ayakkabılık, her yatak odasında dolap yatak yastık, mutfakta tabak tencere kahve makinesi çaydanlık çatal kaşık leğen rende ne ararsanız, odalarda yeterli alanda halı. Ortak alanda koltuklar sehpalar ve büyük orta sehpa, mutfakta masa var. 2balkon, askılar, çamaşır askısı , ütü, süpürge var. Evde yoktur diye getirdiğim hiç bir şeyi kullanmadım. Biz nişan için geldik, akrabalarımızın içine sinmedi gelip baktılar eve bizi götürmek için ve evi öyle beğendiler ki öbür gün misafirliğe geldiler. Kuzenlerimiz ziyaretimize gelebildi. description: First floor apartment in the heart of Moda, Kadıköy, within walking distance to metro, ferry, cafés, and restaurants. Offers a practical and comfortable stay in a prime location. Fully equipped with 1000 Mbps high-speed internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, refrigerator, coffee machine, iron, vacuum, and full kitchenware. Ideal for both short and long stays in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Worth the price and location. Was very clean and the bed was comfortable. Would stay again, yet the unit needs some simple repairs to keep up with the photos. AC worked great.

Location is absolutely good, with 2min walk we can reach restaurants of different cuisines, bar street,supermarket and 5min to the ferry pier. Furnishing is the same as photos show, modern, new, clean. Kitchen is well equipped. Berk is the most helpful and nicest house onwer i have ever met. Thank you!

We had a great stay as a family of six, and the house was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing description perfectly. The location was ideal, situated in a lively neighborhood close to supermarkets and just a short walk to public transport. Berk and his co-hosts were very helpful and responsive hosts throughout our visit. They also arranged airport transport for our group at a fair price, which was much cheaper than getting taxis directly from the airport. We would happily recommend this place to any family visiting the area.

We had a wonderful stay in Kadıköy! The apartment was very clean and comfortable, and the location is absolutely perfect, central, with easy access to everything (restaurants, shops, and transportation / ferries).
The hosts were incredibly responsive and helpful. When we had a question about the water heater, they immediately checked and made sure everything was working smoothly. Their communication and support throughout our stay made the experience seamless.
Overall, this was a fantastic place to stay, and we’d happily return again. Highly recommended!

The accommodation was superb, well maintained, clean and accessible. Close to local good quality restaurants, Kadikoy Metro and the Ferry. Berk is also an excellent host, friendly and
welcoming. He greeted us on arrival and was flexible with our check out time as our flight was in the evening. The property is a short walk from Kadikoy Metro and takes direct route from the airport. Kadikoy is known for its markets and serves one of the best Kunafe desert close by. Picturesque places like Uskudar are also relatively close to visit and taking the ferry everyday to Europe was refreshing. The Istanbul kart is very affordable if you are on a budget and can use the one card on different modes of transport. There are also good places to try out the local Turkish breakfast which is a must. Couple of minor aesthetic issues but overall I would recommend to others and definitely use again.

reviews.text:
Our stay at the apartment was very comfortable! Check in was smooth and Atish had shared very detailed instructions! The apartment had all the amenities we needed like cutlery, iron, hair dryer etc! The kitchen was functional as well! The place was clean and well maintained! Galata area is only 5 mins by walk!
The con will be that going to places from this apartment required some uphill walk! There is no elevator as well so you will have to carry your bags up 2 flights of stairs!
Throughout our stay Atish was very responsive and was quick to provide help with airport transfers too!! Will recommend this place and will stay again! :)

Really enjoyed our stay here! The location is fantastic - just a short walk to Galata Tower and close to everything worth seeing in the area. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable overall. The host was great and accommodating. requested two fans which were provided right away. The one thing I'd flag for the host is that the beds could use updating or replacing. A bit uncomfortable and squeaky. Would still recommend for the location and value.

What we loved…
- Clean
- Large living space
- Well-stocked kitchen
- Nice hot water
- heater worked great in the winter
- Lots of natural light
- Fairly quiet location
- Great communication
- Quick help when we locked ourselves out
What could be improved…
- Blackout curtains in master bedroom (lights from the city make the room as bright as sunrise all night)
- Mattress toppers on the beds (we traveled in Türkiye for a month and these were probably the least comfortable beds we had)

The place is beautiful and clean. Very close to Tophane tram station and walkable distance to Galata Tower and the strip of cafe and restaurants near the Tower. There are no lifts, so plan your luggage well. Also, if you plan to drive in Istanbul,which is not recommended, the driveway is very narrow and paid parking space is about one to two blocks away. All in all, the stay in the apartment is very cosy and comfortable. The host, Ali, is very responsive, too.

A lovely apartment in Beyoglu area, it has a big living room and two comfortable bedrooms, suitable for longer stays. The kitchen has a lot of amenities. Easy to access inspite of no lift. The communication was good and easy all the time as the host answers quickly.
The area is great and everything is nearby walking distance.
The only thing is that the host also offers transfers stating it’s the best way to get a reliable company services in Istanbul, however on the day we were leaving they let us down: the driver was going to be late at least 50 min. We were traveling with a baby and had a later connection flights, it was really a negative “surprise” as all was confirmed in advance.
The host helped us to get a different taxi as we insisted but the whole experience was unpleasant.
